Shift:

Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM

Are you ready to work making the world a safer, healthier place? Join our mission to continuously move science forward; to innovate and advance all aspects of our business to improve the health and safety of our communities and lives.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Quality Assurance Consultants to support food, dietary supplement, ingredient, packaging, and consumer product manufacturers in achieving and maintaining compliance with Food Safety and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements. The ideal candidate has a strong background in food quality systems, regulatory compliance, supplier qualification, auditing, and food safety program development.

This role provides the opportunity to support clients across the food and consumer products industries, helping organizations strengthen quality systems, prepare for regulatory inspections, implement food safety programs, and maintain compliance with applicable FDA and industry requirements.

NOTE:This is an evergreen posting for future positions within our team.  If you would like to be considered during the next round of hirings and have the qualifications, please apply.

NOTE: This is a PRN role with expected hours to be between 15-20 hours per week

Compensation:$62.500 - 76.50 per hour

Responsibilities

  • Conduct assessments and audits of food manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, distribution, and ingredient supplier operations.
  • Evaluate compliance with FDA food regulations, food GMP requirements, and industry food safety standards.
  • Perform gap assessments against applicable regulations and standards, including:
    • 21 CFR Part 117 (Preventive Controls for Human Food)
    • 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplements), as applicable
    • FSMA requirements
    • HACCP principles
    • GFSI-recognized standards (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, IFS)
  • Develop and improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
  • Review and author SOPs, quality procedures, food safety plans, hazard analyses, and preventive control programs.
  • Support clients during FDA inspections, customer audits, certification audits, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate quality events, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Review and assess CAPAs for adequacy, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support supplier qualification, vendor monitoring, and supplier auditing programs.
  • Provide training and coaching on GMPs, food safety requirements, HACCP, sanitation, documentation practices, and inspection readiness.
  • Prepare clear, concise reports, recommendations, and client deliverables.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving food safety regulations and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Quality Assurance, or a related discipline.
  • 15+ years of Quality Assurance, Food Safety, or Regulatory Compliance experience within food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, or consumer product manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • FDA Food Regulations
    • FSMA
    • 21 CFR Part 117
    • HACCP Principles
    • GMP Requirements
    • Food Safety Management Systems
  • Experience conducting internal, supplier, contract manufacturer, and third-party audits.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining GFSI-recognized programs (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of risk assessment, root cause analysis, CAPA development, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Proven experience supporting regulatory inspections and certification audits.
  • Excellent technical writing, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
  • HACCP or PCQI certification preferred.
  • Lead Auditor certification (SQF, BRCGS, ISO 22000, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required (domestic U.S. and occasional international travel).

Preferred Consulting Experience

  • Food Safety Plan development and implementation
  • FDA inspection readiness assessments
  • Food facility registration and compliance programs
  • Supplier qualification and auditing
  • Mock FDA inspections
  • Sanitation program evaluations
  • Environmental monitoring programs
  • Allergen control programs
  • Quality Management System implementation
  • Training and coaching of QA and production personnel

raw.title: Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Platform
raw.excerpt: About Cardlytics Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform.
raw.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Team

At Cardlytics, our goal is to streamline data consumption across the entire organization. We understand that accessible, reliable data underpins informed decision-making and innovative problem-solving. By partnering closely with product and engineering teams, we tailor our solutions to fit their specific workflow needs and make strategic investments in our platform to ensure swift access to data. Our approach is designed to simplify the way teams interact with data, to accelerate time-to-insight to enable Cardlytics teams to harness the full potential of their data for impactful outcomes, and to make deliberate technology choices that keep our data infrastructure cost-effective.

About the Position

Cardlytics is seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Platform to join the team, reporting to the VP of Engineering, Cloud & Data Infrastructure.

We are looking for an experienced technical leader to own and evolve our data compute environment end-to-end on AWS, including defining the next-generation platform direction. In this role, you will make architectural, design, and operational decisions that shape how analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders interact with data at Cardlytics. As data consumption increasingly shifts toward AI and agentic applications, you will also shape the platform's evolution into an AI-ready foundation — spanning the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that these systems depend on. You will combine deep expertise in industry-leading data platforms with the ability to provide technical leadership, define platform standards, and act as the primary technical partner for diverse user groups across the organization.

You will:

  • Architecture and design: Design and evolve the Cardlytics next-generation architecture; establish reference architectures and standards for batch, streaming, ML, and AI/agentic workloads.

  • AI-ready data platform: Build out the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that make Cardlytics data consumable by AI/agentic applications; enable governed, self-service access for both human and machine (LLM/agent) consumers.

  • User enablement: Serve as the primary technical partner for analysts, engineers, and business users; develop self-service guides, onboarding materials, and best-practice documentation to reduce friction across all user groups.

  • Technical leadership: Set technical direction for the platform and mentor engineers across the data and platform teams; drive engineering excellence and best practices, and manage the vendor relationship.

  • Performance and reliability: Define monitoring standards and SLAs, lead performance tuning for Spark jobs, open table formats (e.g. Delta, Hudi), and SQL query engines; own incident response and root-cause analysis.

  • Governance and security: Drive adoption of a unified governance layer (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog) for centralized RBAC, column-level security, data lineage, and metadata management; implement and maintain security best practices including encryption and audit logging.

  • Platform standards and governance: Define the operating model and guardrails for the managed lakehouse platforms (including Databricks on AWS) — compute policies, access model, catalog structure, and cost governance — with day-to-day administration executed by the platform and domain teams working within those standards.

  • Infrastructure as code: Own the CI/CD strategy for lakehouse and data platform deployments (Terraform, GitHub Actions, and platform-native packaging such as Asset Bundles); enforce DevOps practices across engineering teams.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or architecture capacity.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with the leading industry platforms, frameworks, and tools: Databricks, AWS EMR or similar, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark (PySpark), and SQL; with a solid understanding of compute/cluster management on AWS.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering Lakehouse architectures and large-scale ELT/ETL pipelines in production environments.

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting diverse stakeholder groups including analysts, engineers (including ML engineers), and non-technical business users.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, data modeling, and cloud security best practices.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing or operating a semantic layer, feature store, or data ontology / knowledge graph in a production environment.

  • Familiarity with managing data for ML systems and AI/agentic applications, such as training pipelines or inference for LLM-powered and agentic tools.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. If you need accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please email or inform your recruiter.

Role Details

Job Title: Crop Insurance Adjuster

Location: Remote-CA

Reports To: Joe Kemph
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Requisition ID: 2026-710

Requisition Begin Date: 7/17/2026

Role Overview:

ProAg has an exciting opportunity for a Crop Adjuster to join our team in the Sacramento Valley area. Imagine joining a team that’s part of an organization that shares your passion for American Agriculture. A team that understands the challenges ag producers face and the disproportionate financial risks they shoulder. How do you know this team has that passion and understanding? Because many of us at ProAg still farm and ranch ourselves or were raised on the farm or ranch. It’s in our blood.

As a ProAg Crop Adjuster, you will make first contact with our policy holder on the farm or ranch that has just experienced a loss. You will work with our customer to complete field inspections, read maps and aerial photos, measure fields and storage bins, collecting production records of farm commodities, all the while assessing damage or loss. You’ll stick with each claim for each grower until the work is done and the claim is settled.

Reporting to the Area Claims Supervisor, you will work regularly in the field on the farms, climbing grain bins, walking over rough terrain for long distances, etc. You will apply your good judgment, common sense and understanding of ProAg's adjusting guidelines and policy provisions for a variety of Multi-Peril Crop Insurance, Crop Hail, and Named Peril policies.

In this position, you will work from home and cover a territory of the Sacramento Valley. This position will require travel of up to 75%, occasionally even beyond your assigned territory.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Perform fact-finding to determine cause(s) and percentage of loss, exercising your best independent judgment in the handling of claims. Escalate any issues or problems that you can’t resolve to the Area Claims Supervisor.
    • Convey regulations and interpretation of procedure to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.
    • Effectively communicate our position on developing industry topics such as new specialty crops or expanding coverage programs.
    • Continuously expand your knowledge of RMA rules and regulations and ProAg procedures for applying all MPCI, Crop Hail, and Federal Crop Insurance regulations.

What You Bring:

• High school diploma

  • Crop insurance experience in claims or compliance or any ag-related experience and background
    • Analytical skills and attention to detail
    • Basic computer and internet applications
    • Communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
    • Reliable means of transportation and the willingness to travel
    • Completion of your Claim Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) certification and/or any applicable licenses required by State agencies preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
    • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
    • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
    • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment

• Basic life and disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with 6% company match

  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
    • Paid parental leave
    • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
    • Student loan matching program
    • Employee discount program
    • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.
• Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
• Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
• A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
• Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
• The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service. Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing

things.

The pay range is the range THMCC, in good faith, believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. The hired applicant will be offered pay within the entire range based on the candidate’s geographic location, qualifications, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The Company is fully committed to ensuring equal pay opportunities for equal work regardless of color, race, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local pay equity laws.

Disclaimer:

Where the hiring and employment of individuals is not restricted by the foregoing, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law such as the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.]

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

Job Title: Financial Analyst - Retail

Location: US (Remote)


Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin


The Role

As a Finance Analyst II – Retail, you’ll support financial planning, reporting, and analysis for the North America commercial business. You’ll partner with finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver accurate reporting, meaningful insights, and analysis that evaluate business performance and operational effectiveness. You’ll also contribute to process improvements and basic automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and business decision-making.


We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.


Your Impact

  • Support quarterly forecast and annual budget processes by updating models, gathering and validating inputs, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining supporting assumptions and documentation
  • Review submissions for accuracy and completeness, identify potential risks or inconsistencies, and track performance against budget and forecast through variance analysis
  • Prepare summary reports and analysis that clearly communicate key drivers, underlying data, and variances to finance leadership and support decision-making
  • Prepare recurring financial and management reports
  • Perform variance analysis versus budget and forecast, identifying key drivers and trends
  • Assist in maintaining and enhancing financial models used for performance evaluation and reporting
  • Support ad hoc financial analysis and reporting requests for finance leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Gather, analyze, and organize data to support business decisions and initiatives
  • Identify data gaps or inconsistencies and escalate findings appropriately
  • Continually monitor and evaluate processes and recurring deliverables to identify and reduce inefficiencies
  • Assist with basic automation and process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort
  • Create and maintain documentation for recurring reports, models, and processes in accordance with established standards
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, including preparation of reporting materials and variance explanations
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance teams to support accurate and timely close processes
  • Assist in preparing materials for monthly performance reviews

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Accounting, related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 0–2 years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, or related roles
  • Prior experience in Consumer Products or Retail industry a plus
  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and support resolution efforts
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support actionable insights
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based, and evolving environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present financial information
  • Proficient Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and basic financial modeling
  • Experience with Oracle, Hyperion, or similar financial systems preferred

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.
$66,000.00 - $89,100.00

When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Vizient R&D is building new ventures that help healthcare organizations solve complex, high-impact problems. These ventures often begin with ambiguity: emerging client needs, early ideas, evolving business models, and cross-functional teams working quickly to determine what should exist and how to bring it to market responsibly.

We’re looking for a builder-minded product and execution leader to help turn that ambiguity into progress.

In this role, you’ll partner with venture leadership to move ideas from concept to validated product direction to early build execution. You’ll bring strong judgment, design awareness, client orientation, and operating discipline. You’ll also play a key role in structuring and driving client-facing workstreams, ensuring that client discovery, feedback, pilots, implementation planning, and executive touchpoints are tightly connected to venture strategy, product development, and our internal milestones.

This is a role for someone who can shape how early-stage ventures are discovered, designed, built, piloted, launched, and prepared to scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead cross-functional execution across early-stage ventures, partnering with engineering, data science, commercial, legal, privacy, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Prepare and facilitate client working sessions, discovery conversations, pilot reviews, and executive touchpoints that build trust, alignment, and momentum.
  • Translate venture strategy, customer insight, and vision into clear priorities, roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Clarify customer problems, pressure-test assumptions, define MVPs, shape discovery plans, and keep teams focused on user, customer, and business value.
  • Design and run lightweight venture operating systems, including planning rhythms, build reviews, milestone tracking, launch readiness, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
  • Create clarity in ambiguous environments by surfacing the right questions, structuring decisions, and helping teams move forward without unnecessary process.
  • Help teams adopt modern ways of working, including customer discovery, rapid learning loops, agile delivery, disciplined experimentation, prototyping, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resourcing constraints, and unclear ownership early, then drive practical solutions.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 10 or more years of experience leading complex work in product-led, technology-enabled, consulting, innovation, or venture-building environments.
  • Have operated as a product operations leader, product strategy lead, chief of staff, strategic program leader, venture operator, business operations leader, or senior cross-functional execution lead.
  • Have led client-facing workstreams and can translate client input into product, pilot, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Bring strong fluency across discovery, strategy, design tradeoffs, prioritization, MVP definition, launch readiness, experimentation, and success metrics.
  • Can bring structure to ambiguity without creating bureaucracy, moving easily between strategy and detail.
  • Have executive presence, low ego, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without needing to own every decision.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, data, analytics, AI, enterprise software, consulting, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting zero-to-one or one-to-scale product development.
  • Experience introducing new tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation, prototyping methods, or knowledge management practices.
  • Experience partnering with commercial teams on market validation, customer feedback, launch planning, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market readiness.
  • A track record of improving how teams learn from customers, make product decisions, manage dependencies, communicate, and hold themselves accountable

Each Senior Manager is expected to engage credibly across adjacent AI areas and should be able to drive sales opportunities from RFP/RFI to proposals and Statements of Work / staffing plans. Experienced leading client-facing engagements from scoping through delivery, develop and coach manager-level teams, contribute to pursuit activity, and maintain frontier expertise that keeps Accenture's methods current and differentiated. They translate complex AI security concepts into clear, business-relevant narratives for director and C-suite audiences. Contribute to the offering development of Secure AI services and asset / accelerator development to differentiate Accenture Cyber Security.

The Work (Key Responsibilities):

  • Cybersecurity Secure AI solutions that transform clients’ Enterprise AI adoption and secure their AI-enabled operations

  • Design, set-up, and test prototype and production secure AI deployment solutions and ensure that all the pieces work together seamlessly

  • Work with the project team, team leaders, project delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create stand-out [AI Security and Governance] offerings powered by [LLM platforms, frontier grade models, agentic frameworks, and AI/MCP gateways (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI as representative examples]

  • Develop strong relationships with clients and gain the trust of key advisors

  • Make the business case for the [most effective and appropriate secure AI] solution recommended to the client

  • Pitch in on Accenture sales efforts when needed

  • Continue to learn and develop your technical [foundational AI, AI security, emerging technology] and related business expertise

  • Deliver services that meet Accenture Project quality specifications

  • Ability to take initiative to communicate, interact, and collaborate with others to ensure that all aspects of a task are addressed

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 75% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s What You Need

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Cybersecurity with domain expertise in at least one discipline (AppSec, SecOps, IAM, cloud, GRC, or offensive security)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in at least one Secure AI domain: AI security architecture, adversarial AI, or cloud/infrastructure security for AI
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in Agentic coding fluency: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Codex — used in daily delivery practice
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in AI architecture: LLM deployment patterns, agentic/multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, MLOps, A2A, AI Gateways, MCP Gateways
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in AI-specific security: OWASP LLM Top 10, prompt injection, model extraction, supply chain attacks
  • Minimum 1 year of experience with AI governance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, model risk management
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Build strong client relationships and partner with organizations to reimagine their business through innovation
  • Collaborate across diverse communities—including domain experts, engineers, and designers

Job Description

Join us as Start-up Team Manager - To manage complex site operations, ensure compliance with regulatory standards, support site recruitment and training efforts, and facilitate smooth collaboration between trial sites and internal teams to drive the success of clinical studies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with multiple team members in a matrix environment for the effective delivery of site activation within the assigned projects.
    •May oversee site activation for assigned projects according to timelines and quality standard.
    •Assist with coordination of the flow of information between PPD teams, clients, or functional departments involved in site activation.
    •Develop recommended plans/guidelines for project implementation using PPD tools
    •Monitor and analyze project status to ensure successful progress and completion of all assigned projects and provide metrics to upper management.
    •Perform risk identification and provide contingency planning.
    •Collaborate with PPD teams to manage all financial and contractual aspects of studies related to site activation.
    •Work within the team to establish appropriate controls to ensure that project resources and expenses are aligned with budgets with accountability to Global
    Project Management.
    •Administer the technical and operational aspects of the site activation portion of assigned projects, including coordination of feasibility, site contracts, and
    country teams in a matrix environment and manages the assigned scope of work against timelines, costs, and quality.
    •Participating in a functional area leads to identifying and evaluating fundamental issues pertaining to successful site activation, interpreting data on complex issues,
    make good business decisions and ensure solutions are implemented.
    •Develop customer relationships in alignment with assigned projects.

    Education and Experience:
    •Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    •Previous experience to provide the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years’).

    In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    •Able to work well and efficiently with cross-functional teams
    •Consistently demonstrates knowledge of the key principles of cross functional project management
    •Demonstrated organizational and multitasking skills
    •Demonstrated attention to detail
    •Ability to identify and remedy risks related to contractual deliverables and provides appropriate solutions
    •Demonstrates sound understanding of cross-cultural awareness and can adapt appropriately
    •Comprehensive understanding and appreciation of clinical research/ development, including medical and therapeutic areas, phases and medical terminology
    •Demonstrates ability to lead, liaise and coordinate cross-functional project teams
    •Comprehensive knowledge/understanding of clinical development guidelines and Directives

    Working Conditions and Environment:
    •Work is performed in an office/ laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
    •Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
    •Exposure to electrical office equipment.
    •Personal protective equipment is required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
    •Occasional travel, up to 20% of the time, includes travel to site locations both domestic and international. May include travel time outside of normal business hours and/or on weekends.

    Physical Requirements:
    •Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
    •Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
    •Frequent mobility required.
    •Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
    •Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
    •Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
    •Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
    •Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
    •Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
    •Regular and consistent attendance.

    When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Job Description:

GDIT has an opportunity for a DevOps Engineer to design, build, automate, and maintain cloud-native deployment and container orchestration capabilities on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This role is responsible for expanding enterprise CI/CD automation using GitLab, enabling secure and scalable deployments, and supporting mission-focused application teams across the ICAM ecosystem.

This is a fully remote position.

Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:
The ideal candidate is a hands-on DevOps engineer with deep experience in AKS, GitLab pipeline automation, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational patterns. You will support engineering teams by providing secure, repeatable build-and-release automation while ensuring services are deployed reliably and monitored effectively. Your work directly improves deployment velocity, operational resilience, and modernization efforts in support of enterprise ICAM mission requirements.

  • Design, deploy, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, workload identities, ingress controllers, and security configurations.

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for build automation, containerization, quality gates, security scanning, and production release workflows.

  • Build and maintain Helm charts, YAML manifests, templates, and reusable AKS deployment patterns.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) for provisioning and managing cluster and cloud resources.

  • Collaborate with application teams to containerize applications, troubleshoot deployments, and optimize runtime performance.

  • Implement and maintain observability tools (Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK) for monitoring cluster health, logs, and metrics.

  • Ensure secure handling of secrets, certificates, and configuration values using Key Vault or equivalent tools.

  • Troubleshoot AKS workloads, GitLab CI/CD failures, pipeline performance, Kubernetes scaling issues, and service connectivity problems.

  • Document operational procedures, IaC patterns, deployment workflows, troubleshooting guides, and DevOps standards.

  • Support Zero Trust, compliance, and enterprise security requirements through hardened DevOps practices.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Required):

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 5 years’ experience. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.

  • Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.

  • Current DoW 8140 certification (Security+ CE or higher).

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes operations, container lifecycle, networking, scaling, and security.

  • Expertise with GitLab (runners, pipeline configuration, security scanning, artifact management).

  • Proficient with Docker, Helm, YAML, and Kubernetes manifests.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK).

  • Ability to troubleshoot cluster issues, deployments, pods, services, and containerized workloads.

  • Excellent documentation and cross-team collaboration skills

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Desired):

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, Flux, or other GitOps tools.

  • Experience integrating AKS with identity and access controls (AAD workload identities, managed identities).

  • Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, Consul Connect).

  • Experience with container security scanning, SAST/DAST, and vulnerability management.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, enterprise cloud security, and compliance frameworks.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities

  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals

  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off.

  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY:

  • Explore a career in program management at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your passion for the mission and delivering results.

GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact? 


Jabil is seeking a Software Test Development Engineer who will directly contribute to the validation test solutions in place for server hardware manufacturing facilities. You will play a vital role in ensuring the quality and reliability of hardware products in a large-scale production environment.


You will be responsible for contributing to the end-to-end architecture, definition, development and production deployment of production software applications and infrastructure spanning multiple customers and manufacturing regions.


You will also be responsible for interfacing with internal engineering, manufacturing and quality teams and our end customers to ensure your software deliverables meet the rigorous standards of Jabil’s world-class manufacturing environments.


Work Schedule & Hours


This position follows an alternating weekly schedule:

  • Friday–Sunday / Friday–Monday

with a schedule of 6:00 AM–6:00 PM or 8:00 AM–8:00 PM.


What will you do?


  • Test System Development: Design and develop test systems and procedures for hardware validation during the manufacturing processes. This includes creating test plans, test cases, and test scripts to assess the functionality and performance of hardware components or devices such as motherboard, memory, CPU, storage (SSD, HDD, NVMe) and PCIE devices (NIC, GPU, Mezz cards, RAID cards)

  • Test Software Development: Create, validate, release, and maintain test software and scripts that automate the testing process. This software may include code for controlling test equipment, collecting and analyzing data, and generating test reports

  • Test Sustaining: Support and maintenance for the manufacturing server (L10) and rack (L11-L12) level test software and infrastructure deployed at our production facilities, including the implementation of minor system configuration changes (new product variants or revisions)

  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive manufacturing server (L10) and rack (L11-L12) documentation of test procedures, specifications, and Infrastructure

  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, manufacturing engineers, and quality assurance personnel, to ensure alignment on testing requirements and quality standards

Education: 

  • BS degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field is preferred. Relevant experience will also be considered.

Experience: 

  • 1-3 years’ experience in a software role related to manufacturing test development/sustaining with enterprise server, storage or networking products is required

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: 

  • A combination of Education, training and experience will be considered
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with server hardware interaction, validation, and configuration.
  • Experience in 1-2 of the core skills below is required, with expectation to expand skillset as workload requires:
    • Programming/scripting languages:
      • Python,
      • BASH,
      • C, C++, experience a plus
    • Linux development expertise with a solid understanding of its fundamentals:
      • CentOS/Ubuntu
    • Hardware and API solutions for controlling, managing and stressing L10 devices (servers, network and storage SSDs, NVMe):
      • IPMI,
      • Redfish,
      • mprime,
      • FIO,
      • Linpack,
      • ptugen,
      • memtester,
      • iperf
    • Creation and configuration (DHCP, PXE boot, nginx) of Virtual Machines (VMs) using VMWare
    • Leading edge networking systems, hardware, software and protocols including but not limited to enterprise ethernet datacenter switching/routing L1, L2, and L3 (BGP, DHCP Relay, ECMP).
      • Arista CloudVision is a plus
    • Experience with code versioning tools (Git preferred)
    • Strong knowledge of professional software engineering practices for the complete software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
  • Experience working in a multi-site and multi-cultural environments
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10%

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree in EE/CE, Computer Science is preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in the electronics manufacturing industry
  • Experience with test architecture design and methodology
  • Experience with hyperscale customers and environments
  • Experience with 5+ of the core skills described above

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
  • 401K Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Annual Merit Increases
  • Community Volunteer Opportunities
The pay range for this role is $68,800 - $123,800. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan.BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. raw.description:
CVEDIA · Remote, based in the US or Canada · Full-time

About CVEDIA

CVEDIA builds AI video analytics for physical security, smart cities and defense. We train our own models, and we make them run about ten times more efficiently than our competitors, which makes every deployment far more cost-effective. Our models already run in real products on server and edge hardware around the world, and we also ship them on our own appliances.

We have spent years earning the trust of this market by shipping technology that works, moving faster than the incumbents, and standing behind every deployment. That trust is what you will build on.

About the role

We need someone who already knows the North American security channel to turn that trust into growth in the US and Canada.

You will not start from zero. You will take over a healthy book of existing accounts in the region, grow it, and add new integrators, distributors and end users to it. You will report to our Chief Commercial Officer.

In your first months you will get to know our accounts, our partners and our products. Then you will build the pipeline and the channel that carry the region's revenue, and you will tell us what the market wants next.

If you have spent the last several years selling surveillance, access control or integration services, and the integrators, consultants and distributors you know pick up when you call, keep reading.

What you will do

  • Take over our existing accounts in the US and Canada, and grow the revenue each of them brings.
  • Build and close a pipeline of integrators, distributors and enterprise end users across security, retail, transportation and critical infrastructure.
  • Recruit channel partners and equip them to sell CVEDIA when you are not in the room.
  • Own the revenue target for the region, and hit it.
  • Tell our product and engineering teams what the market is saying, including the parts we do not want to hear.

You may be a good fit if

  • You live in the US or Canada.
  • You have at least three years of experience in physical security, such as video surveillance, access control, perimeter protection or systems integration.
  • You have hit B2B revenue targets, and you can show us the deals you closed yourself.

It would be great if you

  • Have a network in the North American integrator and consultant community.
  • Know the video management and camera ecosystems that integrators work with, such as Milestone, Genetec and Axis.
  • Can explain video analytics both to a business buyer and to the engineer who has to deploy it.
  • Have run long deals with many stakeholders, from the first call to the signed contract.
  • Have worked in a company that changed direction when its market did, and helped it adjust.

You do not need to tick every box. If you know the security channel and want to build a region, we would like to hear from you.

Why CVEDIA

  • You can move. There are no layers of approval and no waiting on headquarters between you and the customer. You see the opportunity, you make the call, and we back you.
  • Your voice shapes the product. The people who build our products want to hear what the market tells you, and they act on it.
  • A running start. You inherit real accounts and real momentum in the region, not a blank territory.
  • Pay that follows results. Your pay grows with the revenue you bring in.

Where and how you work

  • We are fully remote and have no offices. We meet in person once a year at a company meetup, usually in Europe.
  • You need some overlap with European afternoons, which are US mornings, for our team meetings.
  • You will travel to about two trade shows a year, and sometimes to meet our larger customers and partners.
  • Pay is a base salary plus commission, and depends on your experience. We will discuss it with you in the first conversation.

How to apply

Please submit your resume/CV in English. Tell us about one deal you closed in physical security: who was involved, how long it took, and what nearly stopped it.

The interview process is a few calls with our managers.

CVEDIA welcomes applicants from every background and country. We judge your work, not your title or your path to it.

Infrastructure Security & Compliance
As a cornerstone of this role, you will ensure our cloud foundations are resilient and compliant
by design.

  • Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, following
  • security best practices and CIS benchmark compliance
  • Build vulnerability management workflows: scanning, triage, and remediation across
  • cloud and endpoint estate

  • response

  • Expert-level experience with Terraform/Terragrunt across multi-account, multi-region
  • environments (5+ years preferred)Kubernetes & Container Security

  • runtime policies.

  • Implement Pod Security Standards, network policies, and RBAC via IaC
  • Establish golden-image programs and container vulnerability scanning/policy enforcement for image registries

CI/CD & Source Code Security
  • In this capacity, you will integrate security directly into the developer experience and supply chain.
  • Design secure CI/CD pipeline infrastructure with SAST/DAST integration and security gates
  • Implement organization-wide GitHub security policies: branch protection, secret scanning, and dependency management

Secrets, Identity & Endpoint Hardening

  • Implement secrets management infrastructure (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) for application and infrastructure credentials
  • Design IAM across cloud environments and support Zero Trust initiatives

Core Skills
  • Technical mastery and a proactive troubleshooting mindset are essential for success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with SOAR/security automation platforms and infrastructure penetration testing
  • Familiarity with GitOps and secure software supply-chain methodologies

DevSecOps Engineer responsible for security-first infrastructure architecture, threat detection, and compliance across our multi-cloud environment, with primary emphasis on AWS. Alibaba Cloud and GCP are expansion targets — current Terraform/Terragrunt modules and CIS benchmark tooling are AWS-only; this role will help build out equivalent coverage for the other platforms. Job Title: Prior Authorization & Billing Specialist

Position type: Full-Time

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Daylight Time , Monday - Friday
Salary rate: $5-$6

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle, process, track, and follow up on prior authorization requests to ensure timely approvals and continuity of patient care.
  • Answer and triage incoming patient calls, gather relevant patient information, address general inquiries, and route concerns to the appropriate healthcare personnel.
  • Process prescription refill requests, coordinate with healthcare providers for approval, and monitor pending requests to ensure timely follow-up.
  • Manage end-to-end medical billing processes, including claims preparation, submission, routing, payment posting, claim status monitoring, and follow-ups on outstanding or denied claims.
  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage manually when insurance information or package selections in Athena EHR require correction.
  • Assist with overflow patient calls during high-volume periods while maintaining professional and empathetic communication.
  • Maintain accurate patient records, insurance information, authorization statuses, and billing documentation in the practice's EHR system.
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and internal team members to resolve patient and administrative concerns.
  • Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with HIPAA regulations when handling patient information.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in medical virtual assistance, healthcare administration, medical billing, prior authorization, or a similar healthcare-related role.
  • Strong understanding of medical administrative workflows, with willingness to undergo training for practice-specific processes.
  • Experience handling patient calls, triage, intake, and patient coordination.
  • Knowledge of prescription refill workflows, insurance eligibility verification, and medical claims processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote healthcare environment while maintaining patient confidentiality.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Strategic Enterprise Account Executive role is part of our Enterprise Sales teams specialized in Financial Services. This team is comprised of elite, forward-thinking sales leaders, industry experts, and strategic visionaries who partner with our most valuable, top-tier clients. Operating in a highly focused model, you will be in charge of a dedicated, select handful of enterprise accounts (or a singular, massive global account) to shape their overarching digital transformation and drive their evolution into an Agentic Enterprise—where autonomous AI agents and humans work together to drive unparalleled success.

We are looking for Strategic Account Executives to lead and orchestrate our highest-value enterprise relationships. In this role, you don't just sell software; you act as a trusted advisor to C-level decision-makers, defining multi-year strategic roadmaps and translating complex business challenges into high-value AI and cloud solutions. You will lead a massive virtual matrix team to deliver a unified vision, balancing short-term commercial execution with long-term partnership value.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured by your ability to drive annual recurring revenue (ARR), expand our strategic footprint within your assigned accounts, maintain high customer satisfaction, and successfully orchestrate internal matrixed teams to execute a unified account strategy.

  • Drive the Account Vision: Partner closely with co-account executives and stakeholders to define, own, and execute a comprehensive, multi-year strategic roadmap for complex, top-tier accounts.
  • Engage the C-Suite: Act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives. Evangelize AI-powered solutions, platform ecosystems, and digital transformation through strategic, value-based selling and compelling Points of View (POVs).
  • Orchestrate the Matrix: Function as the "Strategic Quarterback" leading a large virtual team. Align Specialist AEs, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Global System Integrators (GSIs) to ensure a seamless, unified customer experience.
  • Deliver Measurable Value: Translate deep industry trends into tangible business cases, ROI analyses, and strategic workshops that empower customers to achieve their global business objectives.
  • Maintain Operational Excellence: Navigate high-pressure environments, manage complex annual quota planning, deliver accurate forecasting, and consistently achieve revenue goals.
  • Financial Services Industry: Deep understanding of banking, capital markets, wealth management, or insurance. Experience dealing with strict compliance frameworks, fintech disruptions, data privacy, and core legacy-to-cloud modernization strategies.

Core Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 15+ years of experience in complex, multi-national enterprise SaaS sales, top-tier management consulting, or driving large-scale internal digital transformations within the specified vertical.
  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to convey leadership, direction, and confidence in every interaction, effortlessly adapting your communication style for top-down C-level discussions.
  • Matrix Leadership: Demonstrated success navigating and leading large, cross-functional virtual teams and external partners in a fast-paced environment without formal disciplinary authority.
  • Resilience & Execution: A consistent track record of navigating high-pressure commercial environments, managing complex enterprise deal cycles, and meeting or exceeding high-value revenue quotas.
  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English and German (both written and spoken) to support our regional and global client bases.

Even Better If...

  • You bring a unique hybrid background (e.g., a mix of top-tier strategy consulting and direct Enterprise SaaS sales execution).
  • You possess deep technical or strategic familiarity with next-generation autonomous AI agents, Customer 360 ecosystems, or advanced CRM platforms.
  • You have established, active relationships with C-level stakeholders within the target vertical across Germany and the broader EMEA region.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Social Media Manager who can build, engage, and grow our brand presence across all digital channels.

Why This Role Matters

Brand perception, community engagement, and cultural relevance are your playground. As the Social Media Manager, you are the voice and pulse of High Scale's brand. You’ll be the bridge between our agency's groundbreaking work and the wider industry, translating our internal innovation into a compelling public narrative. You’ll manage our social channels, build an engaged community, and ensure our brand feels like a VIP in every digital interaction.

Your work will directly impact our brand authority, inbound leads, and our reputation as industry leaders. If you thrive on building communities and telling powerful brand stories, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Own Our Social Channels

    • Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy for High Scale's brand (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, etc.).

    • Create, curate, and post engaging content daily that showcases our work, culture, and expertise.

    • Manage the content calendar, ensuring a consistent and high-quality brand presence.

  2. Build & Engage Our Community

    • Serve as the primary voice of the brand, actively responding to comments, DMs, and mentions.

    • Proactively engage with industry leaders, potential clients, and creative partners to build relationships.

    • Develop and implement strategies to grow our follower base and increase engagement rates.

  3. Coordinate Content Creation

    • Work closely with our internal creative, production, and marketing teams to source and repackage campaign highlights, case studies, and behind-the-scenes content.

    • Translate complex agency wins and data into simple, shareable, and impactful social posts.

  4. Represent the Brand & Analyze Trends

    • Act as an ambassador for High Scale, embodying our innovative and data-obsessed culture.

    • Provide insights on industry trends, platform changes, and competitor activity.

    • Track and report on key social media KPIs, using data to refine and optimize your strategy.

Who You Are

  1. A B2B & Creative Storyteller

    • 3–6 years of experience in social media management, preferably for a creative agency, media company, or tech brand.

    • Proven track record of growing and managing professional social media accounts, especially on LinkedIn and Instagram.

  2. Organized & Strategic

    • You can juggle multiple platforms, content formats, and priorities without breaking a sweat.

    • Skilled at building content calendars, managing assets, and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Clear, confident, and persuasive in both written and verbal communication (English fluency required; Spanish is a major plus).

    • You have a sharp, witty, and professional writing style adaptable to different platforms.

  4. Collaborative & Adaptable

    • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

    • Able to work with creative, production, and leadership teams to execute ambitious brand goals.

  5. Data-Driven

    • Track KPIs (engagement, reach, follower growth, leads) to inform decisions and strategy.

    • Comfortable using social media management and analytics tools to report on performance efficiently.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the growth of High Scale's brand and collaborate on top-tier campaigns for global brands.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one breakthrough campaign at a time.

Position Overview

The Corporate Partnerships Coordinator is a dynamic, dual-focus role that blends new business development with operational support for the Corporate Partnerships team. This position drives pipeline growth through proactive outreach, prospect research, and account management, while also ensuring the team runs efficiently through marketing materials development, CRM data integrity, and cross-departmental coordination. The role is critical to achieving Greater Good Charities' ambitious goals of $200M in in-kind and $5M in cash donations annually.

Key Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Corporate Outreach

  • Conduct comprehensive research on potential corporate partners to identify and qualify prospects based on partnership fit and capacity
  • Secure meetings with corporate Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to host Lunch and Learns showcasing GGC's impact and partnership opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate exploratory and expansion meetings for senior team members
  • Prepare briefing materials and talking points for all donor and prospect meetings
  • Support proposal development, presentation materials, and revenue diversification initiatives to drive team achievement of annual goals

CRM Data Management & Analytics

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor, prospect, and partner information in HubSpot
  • Build, manage and execute ZoomInfo and Hubspot sequences to support corporate outreach and engagement
  • Generate reports on prospect pipeline, conversion metrics, and fundraising performance to support strategy and decision-making
  • Track all interactions, proposals, and partnership communications across development staff
  • Support data cleanup, segmentation, and database maintenance to ensure data integrity
  • Assist with annual strategic reviews by preparing comprehensive account summaries

Account Management Support

  • Manage a portfolio of 5-10 smaller corporate partnership accounts spanning assigned accounts and new business development
  • Support stewardship activities, partner communications, and relationship cultivation
  • Coordinate partnership fulfillment and logistics in collaboration with Operations
  • Assist with annual strategic reviews, account planning, and partner reporting
  • Coordinate donor recognition and appreciation activities

Customizing

Materials, Stewardship and Communications

  • Using existing templates, produce compelling one-pagers, fact sheets, pitch decks, and partnership summaries for corporate prospects and partners
  • Produce impact reports and stewardship materials using PowerPoint
  • Ensure brand consistency across all development communications and partner-facing materials
  • Produce professional presentations and collateral for donor meetings and partnership negotiations

Cross-Department Liaison & Coordination

  • Coordinate with Program teams to gather impact stories and outcome data for partner reporting and materials
  • Collaborate with Marketing on donor communications and campaign materials
  • Work with Finance on gift processing and reporting requirements
  • Support Operations with partnership fulfillment and logistics coordination

Administrative Operations

  • Prepare meeting agendas, take notes, and distribute action items
  • Maintain organized filing systems for donor records, partnership agreements, and development documents
  • Support budget tracking and expense management for development activities
  • Handle confidential partner and donor information with discretion and professionalism
  • Support special events and fundraising campaigns as needed

Performance Metrics

  • Contribute to overall department goal of $200M in-kind and $5M in cash
  • Prospect research: 25+ qualified prospects per month
  • Lead conversion rate: 15%+
  • Account retention rate: 90%+

Minimum Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 2-4 years of experience in business development, corporate partnerships, nonprofit development, or a related coordinator role
  • Proficiency in HubSpot CRM and ZoomInfo
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage corporate partners at all levels
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong research and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of corporate partnerships, cause marketing, and major gift processes
  • Commitment to the mission of Greater Good Charities

Working Environment: This position is fully remote. The employee is expected to work 40 hours/week from 9 am – 5 pm in their time zone Monday – Friday. Occasional evening or weekend work for events and urgent deadlines. Some travel may be required for donor meetings and partnership events.

Benefits include 13 paid national holidays, sick leave, paid vacation, parental leave, 401K, medical, dental, and vision benefits.

raw.description:
We're looking for an InternalSales Representative to drive new business at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and inbound lead handling through discovery, proposal, and close, and you will be a direct contributor to the revenue that fuels the company's growth.

This is a small business. This is a lean operation. You will build your own pipeline, run your own process, and manage your own systems without a supporting cast. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy over how you build pipeline, run your process, and close deals. If you are a self-directed seller who takes full ownership of outcomes, moves fast, and thrives without needing structure handed to them, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction, strong case studies, and a differentiated offering
  • High-ownership sales role with full autonomy over pipeline, process, and how you close

What You'll Work On

Outbound Prospecting and Pipeline Generation

  • Identify and research target accounts across U.S. companies that are strong candidates for offshore hiring
  • Conduct outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn to generate pipeline without relying on inbound alone
  • Build and maintain a healthy, organized pipeline of active prospects and follow up consistently without dropping threads
  • Test and iterate on messaging, targeting, and outreach approaches to improve conversion at every stage

Inbound Lead Handling

  • Respond to inbound inquiries quickly and qualify them accurately against the ideal customer profile
  • Move qualified inbound leads through the funnel efficiently and with a high sense of urgency
  • Ensure no inbound lead waits or falls through the cracks

Discovery, Proposal, and Closing

  • Run structured discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, pain points, timeline, and fit
  • Prepare and present tailored proposals that speak to the specific value Hire Overseas delivers for each client
  • Handle objections confidently and move deals to close with a consultative approach
  • Own the deal from first touch through signed agreement and handoff to customer success

CRM and Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate, current records of all outreach, conversations, and deal status in the CRM
  • Keep pipeline data clean and trustworthy so leadership has a real view of what is coming and when
  • Track and report on key sales metrics including activity, pipeline, and revenue contribution

What You Bring

  • Proven B2B sales experience with a track record of closing deals and generating revenue in a full-cycle or high-contribution sales role
  • Self-directed and high-ownership with the ability to build and manage your own pipeline independently
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills with the confidence and presence to run sales conversations at a senior level
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business where processes are still being built and the answers are not always handed to you
  • Organized and disciplined with clean CRM habits and consistent follow-through on every open opportunity
  • Motivated by results and comfortable being measured against revenue targets

Nice to Have

  • Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or B2B professional services
  • Background selling at a startup or founder-led company where you had to build as well as sell
  • Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the business case for remote contractor models
  • Experience with outbound sales tools such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales experience, and walking through how you approach building pipeline from scratch when there is no inbound lead flow to rely on

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you want to own a full sales role at a fast-moving company where your results are directly visible and your decisions actually move the number, this role gives you the autonomy, the product, and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.
