About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Social Media Video Editor who speaks the language of the internet and can turn raw footage into viral gold.

Why This Role Matters

The "For You Page," the scroll, and the hook are your playground. As a Junior Social Media Video Editor, you aren't just cutting video; you are translating brand messages into native social culture. You will be responsible for taking raw influencer content and studio footage and turning it into snappy, engaging, and high-converting assets for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Your work determines if a user stops scrolling or keeps moving. If you are obsessed with pacing, trends, and creating content that feels authentic to the platform, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Edit Native Short-Form Content

    • Assemble and edit fast-paced, engaging videos specifically for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

    • Master the art of the "hook"—editing the first 3 seconds to grab attention instantly using visual disruption, text overlays, and sound.

    • Implement trending audio, native text styles, and platform-specific stickers to make ads feel organic.

  2. Remix & Iterate

    • Take successful ad concepts and create fresh iterations by swapping hooks, changing music, or re-ordering footage to combat creative fatigue.

    • Turn long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts) into bite-sized, viral social clips.

  3. Polish & Enhance

    • Apply dynamic captions (Alex Hormozi style, karaoke style, etc.) that increase watch time and retention.

    • Perform basic color correction and audio mixing to ensure mobile-viewing quality.

    • Add basic motion graphics and transitions to keep the energy high.

  4. Stay Trend-Obsessed

    • Monitor the TikTok Creative Center and Reels trends daily.

    • Proactively pitch new editing styles, audio trends, or visual memes that we can apply to our client brands.

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience editing specifically for social media (personal brand, agency, or freelance).

    • You live on the FYP. You understand current memes, pacing trends, and what makes a video go viral.

  2. Technically Agile

    • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required).

    • Familiarity with After Effects (for motion text) and CapCut (for specific trending effects) is a major plus.

    • You understand aspect ratios, safe zones, and export settings for all social platforms.

  3. Fast & Creative

    • You can turn around an edit in hours, not days. You thrive on the speed of social media.

    • You have a good sense of rhythm and timing—your cuts land perfectly on the beat.

  4. Detail-Oriented

    • You double-check spelling in captions and ensure audio levels are balanced for phone speakers.

    • You are organized with your file management and project structures.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can clearly articulate why you made a creative choice and collaborate effectively with Art Directors remotely.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of major brands and grow into a Senior Editor or Creative Strategist role.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral edit at a time.

Position Summary
The Sr. Product Enablement Manager owns how DataSpring users and customers learn to use our products successfully, and serves as a cross-functional liaison between Product and the teams that support our users. As a shared service for both provider and member data teams, this person identifies where users encounter friction, determines the most effective intervention, and personally creates the solution, including in-app guidance, guided walkthroughs, short-form videos and visual tutorials.

This is a hands-on role that combines content creation and product adoption with ownership of how product information and user feedback flow between teams. The successful candidate works closely with the product team by participating in user acceptance testing, reviewing product analytics, listening to the call center and customer-facing teams, and translating those insights into timely, effective user education, product recommendations and change-readiness communication.

They may also coordinate with external production or Pendo-services partners when additional capacity or specialized expertise is required. They remain accountable for priorities, instructional quality, product accuracy, consistency, and measurable results.

Success is measured by changes in user behavior: fewer avoidable support contacts, faster time to value, stronger feature adoption, successful task completion, and greater user confidence, not simply by volume of content produced.

The Sr. Manager also strengthens the broader team: absorbing overflow from the UX and user enablement teams, providing backup coverage during launches and releases, and reducing the coordination load on Product and Operations leaders.

The successful candidate will be an exceptional plain-language communicator with strong hands-on production skills. They must be comfortable making independent decisions about priorities and formats and producing useful, accurate content under tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.

The Sr. Product Enablement Manager is a full-time, exempt, remote position and reports to the Director, Product Operations.

Specific Responsibilities

Training Needs Assessment and Prioritization

  • Identify and synthesize user-friction signals from support contacts and call drivers, customer interactions, implementation and account teams, internal questions, CSAT and NPS feedback, usability research, and product-usage data.
  • Translate identified friction into clearly defined user-education and product-adoption needs.
  • Prioritize requests according to user impact, business importance, urgency, audience, and production effort.
  • Recommend which requests should not be pursued and clearly communicate the associated tradeoffs.
  • Establish and operate a lightweight intake and triage process so requests are consistently captured, evaluated, prioritized, and resolved.
  • Participate in UAT and product-release activities to identify education needs before new functionality reaches users.
  • Partner with Product Management to distinguish between issues that require training and those that should be addressed through product design.

Content Development and Production

  • Determine the most effective intervention for each need, including a Pendo tooltip, contextual message, guided walkthrough, product tour, short-form video, annotated screenshot, visual tutorial, etc.
  • Design content for distinct user roles, personas, workflows, and levels of product familiarity.
  • Script, record, edit, caption, and publish concise product-training videos using modern screen-capture and authoring tools.
  • Create brief, task-focused content that helps users accomplish a specific goal rather than simply describing product features.
  • Build, test, publish, and maintain Pendo guides, tooltips, walkthroughs, and other in-app experiences.
  • Create visual content that can be reused across in-product guidance, help centers, release communications, and customer-support channels.
  • Apply consistent brand, voice, terminology, and plain-language standards for a nontechnical healthcare audience.
  • Ensure content meets applicable accessibility requirements, including captions, transcripts, alternative text, keyboard considerations, readable contrast, and Section 508/WCAG standards.
  • Maintain editable source files, templates, naming conventions, version history, and a reusable content library.
  • Use AI-assisted and automated production tools appropriately to shorten production cycles while maintaining accuracy, security, and editorial quality.
  • Plan and run in-app engagement campaigns that drive awareness and adoption of new and underused features.

Measurement and Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate training effectiveness using Pendo analytics, support data, task completion, feature adoption, depth of use, and time to first successful use.
  • Test and improve content based on behavioral data and user feedback.
  • Revise, replace, consolidate, or retire content that is outdated, redundant, or failing to change user behavior.
  • Identify fast-follow priorities based on observed user friction, feature-adoption patterns, customer feedback, and support-center questions and call drivers.

Content and Platform Governance

  • Establish training content standards, review processes, and clear ownership so training, help content, and product messaging stay aligned with each release.
  • Lead Pendo governance, including standards for page and feature tagging, guide creation, targeting, review, and publishing across teams.
  • Help define guidelines for the responsible use of AI tools in content creation, covering accuracy, security, privacy, and editorial review.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Product Liaison

  • Work closely with Product Management, UX, Customer Support, Implementations, Sales, Client Partnerships, Marketing & Communications, Compliance, and other subject-matter experts.
  • Serve as a shared resource for both provider and member data teams, coordinating product enablement and communication across both.
  • Help teams distinguish between a product problem, communication problem, support problem, and education problem.
  • Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Solutions Center to review call drivers and user feedback on a regular cadence; compare support themes with Pendo behavior data.
  • Help keep Solutions Center training and knowledge resources current with each release.
  • Create presentations that explain product changes, user impact, and adoption results to leadership and go-to-market teams.
  • Support the UX and user enablement teams by absorbing overflow work and providing backup coverage during launches and releases.

Skills

Required

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain complex workflows clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently create short-form video, in-app guidance, and written or visual instructional content.
  • Hands-on experience with a digital adoption platform; Pendo experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated video-production experience, including screen capture, editing, captions, visual callouts, and narration or voiceover management.
  • Sound judgment regarding content priority, instructional format, audience needs, and appropriate depth.
  • Ability to interpret product analytics, support data, and customer feedback and draw defensible conclusions.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver useful, accurate content under significant deadline pressure.
  • Comfort operating in an environment with shifting priorities and incomplete information.
  • Ability to serve as the primary product-education resource and continue moving work forward without extensive direction.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to give external partners and internal contributors clear, actionable feedback.
  • Strong cross-functional facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams and influence decisions without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Experience developing education for external users and customers for a SaaS product or technology-enabled service.
  • Experience building and publishing Pendo guides and interpreting Pendo analytics.
  • Working knowledge of adult-learning, instructional-design, microlearning, and performance-support principles.
  • Experience with healthcare technology, provider workflows, or healthcare data.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG requirements as applied to digital learning content.
  • Experience administering Pendo or leading digital-adoption governance across multiple teams.
  • Experience partnering with customer support or call-center teams to turn contact data into product, content, or training improvements.
  • Experience creating executive presentations and release communications.
  • Experience establishing content governance or standards for AI-assisted content creation.

Experience & Education

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience creating customer education, software product training, product adoption, or enablement content, including work across product, support, and customer-facing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing content for a software product or technology-enabled service.
  • Hands-on experience with a digital adoption platform required; Pendo experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working within product-development and release cycles.
  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Candidates should be prepared to share a portfolio that includes at least one software-training video and one example of in-app, visual, or written guidance they personally created.
  • Hands-on experience with several of the following or comparable tools:
    • Pendo or another digital adoption platform
    • Camtasia, Descript, Adobe Premiere Pro, Loom, or comparable screen-capture and video-editing software
    • Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, or comparable content-authoring tools
    • AI-assisted scripting, editing, voice, transcription, and content-production tools
    • Jira and Confluence
    • Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.

raw.excerpt: WHAT WE DONitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless.
raw.description:
WHAT WE DO

Nitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless. Since launching Riskalyze in 2011, we've been on a mission to create what we call Catalyst Moments — those powerful instances when an advisor leads a client from confused and fearful to confident and fearless.

Nitrogen is a connected suite of advisor products designed to showcase the value of advice in every client meeting. Combining agentic AI with Risk Alignment, Insurance Alignment, Investment Research, Income Planning, Tax Intelligence, and Legacy Planning, combining agentic AI with trusted, deterministic analytics to turn complex financial insights into persuasive visuals. The result: clearer conversations, stronger relationships, and advisors who can prove their value in every client meeting.

Trusted by tens of thousands of advisors, backed by an industry-leading Net Promoter Score of 71, and the first wealthtech company to earn ISO 42001 certification, Nitrogen is built on thirteen years of advisor data and half a trillion dollars in assets on platform. We invented the Risk Number®, built on a Nobel Prize-winning academic framework, and we champion the Fearless Investing Movement — because a world empowered to invest fearlessly starts with empowered advisors.

Nitrogen is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We are committed to being fair and intentional in our hiring decisions by reviewing every application thoroughly.

WHY DESIGN MATTERS AT NITROGEN

The last mile of financial advice isn't more data; it's clarity. It's the moment someone goes from confused to fearless. At Nitrogen, we help financial advisors showcase the value of advice in every client interaction. A lot of that comes down to great design. An advisor can have powerful analytics, but if their client can't understand what it means for their future, it doesn't really help them. Our job is to make that part clear, so clients walk away feeling confident.

Three ideas guide how we design and build at Nitrogen:

  • AI does the work. Nucleus™, our AI engine, doesn't just summarize or make suggestions. It takes action for advisors. You'll help design how that works, so advisors understand what it's doing, when it needs their input, and how to stay in control.
  • Connected intelligence makes the work right. Our analytics are grounded in proven methodology, not AI-generated math, and our products are designed to work better together. You'll help create the shared patterns and connected experiences that make the whole suite feel cohesive.
  • Persuasive visuals make the client feel it. You'll turn complex financial data into visuals that help clients understand where they stand, see the value of advice, and feel confident about what's next.

THE ROLE

This is a chance to help shape what AI-native financial advice looks like. You'll have real influence over product decisions, room to experiment with new ways of working, and the opportunity to set a high bar for design in a complex product that advisors rely on every day. Our advisors love Nitrogen, and it shows in our Net Promoter Score of 71.

We're a small design team with a well-structured process that moves fast. Every designer owns real parts of the product from start to finish. You'll work closely with a PM and an engineering lead to figure out what problems to solve, shape solutions, and see them through until they ship.

You don't need an extensive background in wealth management to be a great fit. Most of us didn't either when we started. We have insurance experts, CFPs, and people who've built advisor tools for over a decade on the team, and they'll help get you up to speed fast. What matters more is your curiosity, your ability to make complex ideas clear, high standards for your own work, and your drive to make a real impact.

We're a fully remote team spanning Poland to California, and we welcome applicants across time zones in the US. Our core collaboration hours are Monday through Friday, 10am to 2pm ET, and you'll need to be reliably available during that time to collaborate with teammates, including our engineers in Poland. Some of our most valuable work happens during these overlapping hours, when we can work through problems, make decisions, and move ideas forward together quickly in real time. You won't be in meetings the entire time, but we do expect you to be available to collaborate during that window. Outside those hours, you have the flexibility to manage your own focused design time. We trust you to work with strong accountability, autonomy, and a commitment to delivering results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work with your PM and engineering lead to shape new features, from a rough idea to a plan we can commit to. We work in structured, six-week development cycles, so a big part of the job is asking good questions early, exploring tradeoffs, and figuring out what's worth building.
  • Design how Nucleus works when it takes action for advisors: how it communicates progress, handles uncertainty or mistakes, and knows when to bring a person back into the loop.
  • Take complicated topics like investment risk, portfolio analysis, and insurance coverage, and turn them into visuals that make the numbers click, from how much a portfolio could swing in a bad year to whether a family's coverage is actually on track.
  • Build and maintain reusable design components, patterns, and documentation that keep our products consistent and give engineers and AI tools a reliable foundation to build from.
  • Prototype early and often. AI-powered prototyping is a core part of how we work, especially early on. You'll turn ideas into working experiences quickly, explore multiple approaches, and learn before committing to a direction. We use Figma, v0, Claude, and Devin every day.
  • Work closely with engineering through implementation, reviewing what's built and refining the details so what ships meets our high quality bar.
  • Share what you learn, improve how we work, and create reusable AI workflows that help all of us move faster without sacrificing quality.

Requirements

  • Exceptional visual product design skills. You can take a complex, data-dense product and make it feel clear, intuitive, and polished. Your portfolio shows a strong eye for layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and the details that make an experience feel finished.
  • A track record of shipping. You've designed and shipped software people rely on, can explain the decisions behind them, and have results or lessons learned to show for it.
  • Demonstrated AI proficiency. AI tools are already part of how you work. You use them to explore ideas, accelerate your process, and build working prototypes, not just generate static mockups. You can show us what you've built and explain how AI has changed the way you design.
  • An understanding of agentic design. You think about what makes AI experiences understandable and trustworthy, including how to communicate what the AI is doing, handle uncertainty and errors, and keep people in control.
  • Experience working with design systems. You're comfortable designing within established patterns, contributing new components when needed, and thinking about how systems scale across products and the people and tools building them.
  • Strong sense of ownership. You've owned big pieces of a product, and you work well with PMs and engineers without needing much oversight.
  • Curiosity and a bias toward learning. You can get your head around an unfamiliar domain quickly, identify what you need to learn, and use research, experimentation, and real feedback to guide your next move.
  • Conviction and humility. You're willing to ask hard questions, experiment, and advocate for what you believe is right. You're just as willing to listen, take feedback, and change your mind when you learn something new.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience designing and shipping AI-powered products, particularly agentic workflows or other experiences where AI takes action on behalf of users.
  • Experience with investing, finance, or insurance products. Or you're the friend people ask about their 401(k), or the one who's always tinkering with the newest AI tool on the weekend.
  • Experience leading a design system initiative or major product redesign, including templates, modular components, or guidelines that help AI agents create more consistent work.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React, and/or comfort using front-end AI tools to polish an experience before it ships.

The expected compensation range for this role is a $130k-$140k + annual bonus target.

Lesser experience may result in lower compensation and greater experience may result in greater compensation than the stated range.

Benefits

Financial Benefits & Perks

  • 4% 401(k) Match. Our employees invest so much in our company and we love getting to invest in them. The company will match your contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to 4% of your total annual compensation.
  • Free Financial Planning Services. By working at a financial technology company, you get the benefit of fantastic financial advice. This is offered to all employees wanting expert guidance on how to handle their money.

Health & Family

  • Medical, Dental & Vision insurance plans. We want to help keep you (and your family) healthy! Comprehensive health insurance options for you & your family.
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) available depending on chosen medical plan. We know that investment risk isn’t a one-size-fits all and neither are your health savings options!
  • Generous maternity & paternity leave for either the birth or adoption of a child. Mom's & Dad's need time with their new family members!
  • Discounted pet insurance available. Pets are family too!!

Time Away & Culture

  • 3 weeks vacation & 1 week sick time per year.Take the time you need for fun or simply time to recover from not feeling well.
  • 11 paid company holidays per year. Enjoy your time off; you deserve it!
  • Remote & in-person team building activities help our employees stay connected and engaged. We absolutely love to hype our people up!
  • Company wide meetings held by our CEO benefit all employees by keeping everyone in the loop. We are one team, and we tackle projects together.
  • Employee development is our priority. From leadership training, to mentorship, to industry resources, we care about progressing you in your career.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

While you can learn a lot from a job description, you may have more questions, and that’s totally okay! We encourage all individuals interested in working at Nitrogen to learn more about us by checking us out on our website and social media platforms:

Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Buscamos Asistentes Virtuales Administrativos altamente organizados, proactivos y orientados al detalle para formar parte de nuestra red de profesionales. Como empresa de staffing, asignamos a nuestros asistentes virtuales a clientes que requieren apoyo remoto en diversos rubros.

Un asistente virtual puede trabajar en diferentes áreas realizando tareas relacionadas con administración general, ventas, servicio al cliente, investigación, generación de prospectos, llamadas en frío, contabilidad, reclutamiento, manejo de redes sociales básicas, redacción de contenido e incluso marketing.Para estos proyectos requerimos que los solicitantes, tengan una educación universitaria (completa o en curso) y alguna experiencia laboral, que demuestre que pueden trabajar con éxito en un entorno profesional.

​
Ejemplos de actividades realizadas por nuestros asistentes:

  • Gestionar correos electrónicos, agendas y llamadas telefónicas.

  • Organizar reuniones, preparar actas y realizar seguimientos.

  • Realizar tareas de ingreso y manejo de datos en sistemas CRM u hojas de cálculo.

  • Elaborar y dar formato a documentos, presentaciones y reportes.

  • Coordinar proyectos administrativos o tareas específicas solicitadas por el cliente.

  • Brindar atención al cliente por canales digitales (correo, chat, etc.).

  • Realizar gestiones básicas de facturación, cobros y pagos, según necesidad del cliente.

  • Otras tareas administrativas asignadas.


Requirements

Requisitos

El perfil típico de un miembro del equipo de LoVirtual es un graduado/estudiante universitario con buenas habilidades comunicativas.Nuestros miembros tienen dominio de herramientas ofimáticas como Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, entre otros. En última instancia, debe poder manejar proyectos y entregar un trabajo de alta calidad con una supervisión mínima.

Tenga en cuenta que nuestro proceso de contratación incluye la evaluación de sus habilidades en todas estas áreas durante un período de prueba para que podamos considerar ubicarlo en el proyecto que mejor se adapte a sus habilidades.Si acepta ser parte de este proceso y tiene éxito, se lo considerará para cualquiera de los puestos anteriores en función de su experiencia, educación, capacitación, intereses y desempeño durante la Prueba (esto se explicará completamente más adelante en el proceso).

Tenga en cuenta que los roles descritos anteriormente involucran una lista general de tareas potenciales, pero nuestros proyectos podrían incluir solo algunas de las funciones enumeradas o similares que no se describen en esta descripción del rol.
Uno de nuestros mayores objetivos es conectar el mejor talento latinoamericano con clientes internacionales, brindando una experiencia multicultural que fomente la diversidad y la inclusión.LoVirtualse enfoca en crear un ambiente de trabajo donde los miembros de nuestro equipo puedan prosperar, innovar y alcanzar su máximo potencial.Por lo tanto, valoramos a los miembros del equipo que trabajan arduamente y buscan oportunidades de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.

Valoramos la experiencia laboral relevante y las habilidades "duras", pero también buscamos personas inteligentes que posean las habilidades blandas que los harán exitosos como miembros remotos del equipo, como hábitos de trabajo duro, buena comunicación, puntualidad, sentido común, aprendizaje rápido, iniciativa, orientación al detalle, profesionalidad, actitud positiva, constancia, seriedad y honestidad.

Trabajar desde casa no es para todos, pero este trabajo virtual puede ser realmente satisfactorio si puede trabajar de forma independiente con una supervisión mínima.Queremos que los miembros de nuestro equipo tengan éxito, por lo que hemos basado nuestros requisitos en las condiciones mínimas necesarias para garantizar que los miembros puedan prosperar en su entorno de trabajo, para ello, es requisito las herramientas y la infraestructura para que trabajen de manera productiva entre ellos:

  • Un espacio de trabajo tranquilo.

  • Computadora portátil con cámara web y auriculares (mínimo 8 GB de RAM)

  • Conexión a Internet y energía estable (al menos 10 Mbps de velocidad de descarga y 5 Mbps de velocidad de carga)..

  • Un lugar de trabajo de respaldo en caso de que sufran un corte de energía o falla de Internet, así como una opción secundaria de Internet de respaldo (punto de acceso móvil, Multibam, WiPod, Internet Satelital, etc.)

  • Teléfono inteligente


Benefits

Beneficios:

Una remuneración competitiva basada en la experiencia y las habilidades del candidato.

Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento dentro de la empresa.

Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y amigable.

Flexibilidad para trabajar desde casa.

Pago en divisas (USD) a través de la plataforma Ontop.

raw.description:
PeopleTools Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PeopleTools Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $95,000–$110,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced PeopleTools Consultant responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, upgrade, and ongoing technical operation of enterprise PeopleSoft environments. In this role you will own the technical backbone of the PeopleSoft platform — including PeopleTools upgrades, image applications, security configurations, search server operations, and integration with cloud and middleware platforms. The ideal candidate will combine deep PeopleTools and PeopleSoft administration experience with strong fundamentals in Oracle database, Linux/Unix, and modern DevOps practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PeopleSoft PeopleTools administration experience.
  • Hands-on experience with PeopleTools upgrades and PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM).
  • Strong experience with WebLogic, Tuxedo, and PeopleSoft application/process scheduler servers.
  • Experience administering Elasticsearch / OpenSearch in support of PeopleSoft.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration.
  • Strong Linux/Unix skills and shell scripting experience.
  • Familiarity with PeopleSoft Cloud Manager or equivalent automation tooling.
  • Experience operating HA/DR for PeopleSoft.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications

Please review the job details below.

Lanteris Space is seeking a Manager of Avionics Engineering to join our team in San Jose CA. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. this role, you will report to the Avionics Subsystem Senior Manager and be responsible for leading an engineering team responsible for Avionics Unit Development, Command and Data Handling subsystem design, analysis, hardware procurement, and testing. You and your team will work alongside a highly cross-functional team and will have the ability to impact all phases of spacecraft design and build: working to build out product roadmaps and develop new Avionics architectures for our various spacecraft platforms, implementation of designs with Systems and Subsystem Engineering, powering on the spacecraft and collecting data for the first time in AIT, and finally, performing orbit raising activities as the fully built-up spacecraft is on its way to performing its mission.

You are technical in nature. You are business savvy. You can build teams and develop people.

Responsibilities

  • Lead your team: responsible for Spacecraft Subsystem Command and Data Handling (C&DH). This includes working cross-functionally to design C&DH subsystem architecture, wirelists, command & telemetry databases, and data buses. Furthermore, working alongside Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) to resolve on-the-floor anomalies and supporting spacecraft launch and orbit raising operations.
  • Focus on your team: Mentor, train, develop, provide opportunities for your team members based on personal, professional and business needs.
  • Ensure the highest quality: of all deliverables to stakeholders.
  • Foster a collaborative working environment: within your team as well as cross-functionally across the organization
  • Be a partner: Support Internal and external stakeholders in the development of new architectures and hardware and collaboration with Systems Engineering and AIT to ensure clean hand-offs
  • Continuously improve: Tease out product and/or process inefficiencies and make it better
  • Own your portfolio cost models and budget: you proactively manage your budget, identify risks and opportunities to your work, and own your cost models to be used for new business proposals
  • Own your portfolio schedule: you proactively manage to your schedule, and work alongside your peers to ensure stakeholder needs are met

Minimum Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • A B.S. degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field. M.S. degree preferred.
  • 8 years of experience in aerospace or related field working electronics or electrical systems or product development for high reliability, space-based systems or for critical systems in fields such as automotive, transportation, or medical device, including experience in managing and/or leading engineering/product teams or projects.
  • Experience leading electrical engineering designs through the full lifecycle
  • Familiarity with the space environment and its effect on satellite systems. Exposure to both Radiation Hardened (Rad Hard) designs and commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) designs will be great, which should position you to support growing our product lines across various space environment missions
  • Experience with Analog, Digital, and Mixed-signal circuits
  • Knowledge of electronics design and electrical communication standards, such as RS-422/485, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire/Ethernet, CAN, SPI, I2C
  • Knowledge of common circuit blocks including filters, power supplies, and microcontrollers
  • Exposure to FPGA hardware implementation for flight applications in the aerospace industry
  • Knowledge of Design for excellence (DFX), root cause, derating, and related analyses
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere

Amazing to have

  • Prior Command and Data Handling Experience, including sound knowledge of related physical components and their relationships within various systems
  • Experience supporting new business development/proposals, including estimating rough order of magnitude costs and schedules
  • Self-motivated problem solver, with strong communication, and documentation skills

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Hybrid Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 8+ years
Salary - $100K – $150K
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define multi-cloud strategy, target-state architecture, and adoption guardrails across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI as relevant.
  • Design federated identity, SSO, and cross-cloud authorization patterns that let workloads and engineers move between providers without compromising on least-privilege, auditability, or operational simplicity.
  • Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.
  • Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.
  • Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.
  • Drive multi-cloud observability, security monitoring, and unified policy enforcement, designing approaches that work consistently across providers and avoid the complexity of fragmented per-cloud tooling stacks.
  • Establish FinOps practices that operate consistently across multiple cloud providers.
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity strategies that span clouds.
  • Partner with security architects on multi-cloud security models, KMS strategies, and key management.
  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on when to use cloud-agnostic versus cloud-native patterns.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.
  • Stay current with multi-cloud platform and tooling developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”

Talent Acquisition Specialist

As a Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead end-to-end recruitment for critical technology roles across EMEA and AMER/LATAM. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, delivery teams, and hiring managers to identify and attract high-quality technical talent for RE Partners and our client engagements.

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for technical roles across EMEA, North America, and LATAM, including Software Engineering, QA/SDET, DevOps/SRE, Cloud, Data, Security, Architecture, and Engineering Leadership positions.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Delivery Managers, and other hiring stakeholders to translate technical and business requirements into effective recruiting strategies.

  • Source and engage passive technical candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, professional communities, referrals, talent databases, and other sourcing channels.
  • Conduct recruiter screens to assess candidate experience, technical background, career progression, communication skills, motivation, availability, and overall alignment with role requirements.
  • Coordinate technical assessments and interview processes with engineering interviewers and hiring teams.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and anticipated technology needs.
  • Deliver an outstanding candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Provide hiring managers with market intelligence on talent availability, compensation expectations, technology trends, geographic differences, and competitive hiring activity.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in the ATS and provide regular recruitment metrics and pipeline reporting.
  • Track recruiting KPIs such as time-to-fill, time-to-submit, conversion rates, offer acceptance rates, sourcing effectiveness, and pipeline health.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, interview workflows, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.

To Be Successful You Will Need:

  • Strong ability to distinguish between technical roles, seniority levels, and relevant versus adjacent candidate experience.
  • Experience partnering directly with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and senior hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong sourcing capabilities and proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and other recruiting tools.
  • Understanding of technical talent markets across EMEA, North America, and LATAM.
  • Exceptional professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple technical requisitions simultaneously.
  • Cultural competence and ability to adapt recruiting approaches across different countries and regions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate across multiple time zones.

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience recruiting for consulting organizations, technology vendors, or financial-services clients.
  • Technical background or demonstrated understanding of software engineering and the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience recruiting highly specialized or senior technical talent, including Staff/Principal Engineers and Architects.
  • Experience with AI-assisted sourcing or recruiting tools.
  • Experience designing or improving technical interview and assessment processes.
  • Relevant recruiting or HR certifications.
  • Knowledge of additional languages commonly used across EMEA or LATAM.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a CMOP LEAD supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a CMOP Lead supporting VA’s Consolidated Mail Outpatient Pharmacy (CMOP) operations, you will ensure today is efficient and secure—and tomorrow is smarter.

GDIT is partnering with VA to provide enterprise‑level support for national and regional CMOP systems that process millions of prescriptions annually. As the CMOP LEAD, you will oversee database operations, system performance, and cross‑site coordination to maintain 99.9% database uptime and ensure the accuracy, availability, and reliability of pharmacy workflows that directly impact Veteran care. You will lead technical support, collaborate with regional and national CMOP teams, manage incident response, and guide continuous improvement across seven CMOP production sites.

Your leadership ensures that CMOP systems remain stable, secure, compliant, and optimized to support VA’s high‑volume pharmaceutical operations.


HOW A CMOP LEAD WILL MAKE A DIFFERENCE

  • Lead operations for approximately 700 CMOP databases supporting 5,000–7,000 daily users across seven national/regional CMOP sites.
    • Ensure 99.9% database uptime during production operations, minimizing outages and maintaining mission‑critical pharmacy workflows.

    • Direct incident response and 24x7 on‑call coverage to resolve urgent issues impacting prescription processing.
    • Lead remediation of security findings, ensuring no recurring issues and compliance with VA standards.
    • Drive proactive monitoring using Dynatrace, Splunk, and SolarWinds to detect and resolve performance risks.
    • Oversee ServiceNow ticket management for all CMOP database-related issues to ensure timely resolution and minimal operational disruption.
    • Provide documentation, reporting, and guidance to CMOP stakeholders, including database metadata, application processes, and transaction integrity support.
    • Recommend and implement improvements to maintain accuracy, efficiency, and reliability across CMOP systems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with VA CMOP systems or large‑scale healthcare pharmacy operations.
    • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, SolarWinds, or similar monitoring platforms.
    • Experience with compliance, security remediation, and performance metrics reporting.

raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Casting Talent specialist who can hunt down the fresh faces, authentic voices, and charismatic creators that define our brands.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, charisma, and connection are your playground. In the world of performance marketing, the "face" of the ad is often the biggest variable in its success. As a Casting Talent specialist, you are the detective and the connector. You aren't just filling roles; you are finding the specific personalities that make a viewer stop scrolling and start listening.

Your ability to distinguish between "cringe" acting and genuine influence will directly impact the ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) of our clients. If you have a natural eye for potential and love building relationships with creators, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Scout & Source Creators

    • Proactively hunt for new talent on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and casting platforms. You won't just wait for applications; you will go out and find the hidden gems.

    • Build a diverse roster of actors, models, UGC creators, and real-people testimonials suitable for beauty, fashion, and tech brands.

    • Identify talent that matches specific demographic and psychographic profiles provided by the Strategy team.

  2. Vet for Performance

    • Review self-tapes and past content to ensure talent has on-camera charisma, good lighting setups (for remote creators), and the ability to deliver lines naturally.

    • Conduct brief audition interviews to test communication skills and professionalism.

  3. Manage Talent Relationships

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for our talent roster, building strong, long-term relationships.

    • Brief talent clearly on project requirements, scripts, and visual direction to ensure they nail the shoot on the first try.

    • Negotiate rates and usage rights effectively, maximizing value for our clients.

  4. Database Management

    • Maintain an organized, tagged database of talent (e.g., "Mom aged 30-40," "Gen Z Skincare Enthusiast") for rapid deployment on new campaigns.

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience in casting, influencer marketing, or talent management.

    • You understand the "vibe" of different platforms. You know what a "TikTok face" looks like versus a "TV commercial face."

  2. A Good Judge of Character

    • You have high emotional intelligence. You can tell within seconds of a video if someone is authentic or "acting."

    • You are inclusive and adept at finding diverse talent that represents the real world.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are comfortable negotiating with agents and guiding creators through a brief.

    • You are responsive and professional, representing High Scale well in the creator community.

  4. Organized & Fast

    • Casting often happens on tight timelines. You can manage multiple casting calls simultaneously without getting flustered.

    • You are diligent with paperwork, agreements, and contact details.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and grow into a Senior Casting Director or Producer role.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly cast role at a time.

This role is responsible for the strategic leadership, management and direction of a team of Strategic Client Managers and Senior Client Managers accountable for achieving assigned financial, retention, growth and client experience objectives across an assigned Large Group portfolio for Cigna Global Health Benefits (GHB) within the Americas. The portfolio includes some of GHB’s largest clients, predominantly experience-rated accounts with complex global health benefit needs. The role leads the team in developing proactive, consultative client strategies, delivering tailored account management and maintaining strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, brokers and key internal matrix partners. This position reports to the Vice President of Client Management – Large Group Segment for GHB.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Directly manages a team of Strategic Client Managers and Senior Client Managers serving GHB’s largest clients and is accountable for the overall performance of the assigned Large Group portfolio against key measures, including persistency, revenue, membership growth, earnings, client experience and execution of strategic priorities.
  • Drives disciplined portfolio management and renewal execution across a predominantly experience-rated Large Group portfolio, including early identification of retention and earnings risks and development of multi-year, client-specific strategies. Partners with Underwriting, Finance and Sales to understand claims experience, trend and renewal pricing, and to develop commercially sound renewal approaches that balance client needs, sustainable persistency, profitable growth and earnings objectives.
  • Accountable for hiring, leading, coaching and developing Strategic Client Managers and Senior Client Managers. Establishes clear expectations and tailors coaching to the scope and complexity of each role, strengthening executive relationship management, financial acumen, consultative account planning, negotiation and cross-functional leadership capabilities. Builds team capacity to manage complex Large Group relationships and supports professional growth and succession readiness.
  • Serves in a market-facing leadership capacity for key Large Group accounts and producer/broker relationships. Establishes, builds and grows strategic relationships with senior client and broker stakeholders, including participation in executive business reviews, long-term benefit strategy discussions, complex renewal negotiations and critical issue resolution.
  • Develops strong internal relationships with matrix partners across Sales, Underwriting, Finance, Operations, Clinical, Network, Product and other functions that support the Large Group portfolio. Uses these partnerships to coordinate solutions for complex multinational benefit needs, improve execution, address systemic issues and deliver a differentiated, high-quality client and customer experience.
  • Translates annual Client Management goals, business priorities and portfolio strategies into clear team objectives and operating rhythms. Ensures disciplined multi-year account planning, early renewal readiness, risk management and follow-through across the Large Group portfolio. Coaches the team to articulate client-specific value through financial, clinical, access and service outcomes, partnering with matrix teams to support credible, data-informed client discussions.
  • Leads and supports the team through complex client and broker escalations, ensuring clear ownership, executive-level communication, timely resolution and effective service recovery. Identifies recurring themes and partners across the organization to address root causes and improve the client experience.
  • Supports and helps lead business planning and focused strategies for the Large Group segment, including portfolio performance, renewal and retention priorities, growth opportunities, client value demonstration, and execution of enterprise and GHB initiatives. May provide strategic ownership, implementation leadership, consultation or other ad hoc support based on business needs throughout the year.
  • Acts as a senior voice for Large Group client and marketplace needs, ensuring that emerging themes, risks and opportunities are understood and acted upon across GHB. Promotes consistent execution and the sharing of best practices across Client Management, Sales and matrix partners.
  • Responsible for establishing and driving effective partnerships within other areas of the Cigna Enterprise, including but not limited to: CHC domestic, Evernorth and other International Health partners & regions (Europe, Asia, Middle East, etc.).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent relevant experience required; MBA preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in account management or benefit consulting, including management of large, complex employer client relationships.
  • 5+ years employee benefit experience
  • Prior management/supervisory experience and/or demonstrated competencies in this area, including the ability to coach experienced client management professionals responsible for complex accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the global health benefits landscape, complex employer-sponsored benefit programs, and the needs of large multinational clients preferred.
  • Exceptional relationship and account management skills required, with demonstrated ability to influence senior client and broker stakeholders; strong negotiation, renewal and escalation-management capabilities are critical.
  • Strong ability to partner with internal and external resources and clients to achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborate, communicate and influence to create win-win solutions with internal and external partners.
  • Demonstrated experience with consultative client management methodologies.
  • Must be able to work in fast paced environment

As a Customer Support Agent, you'll play a crucial role in providing high-quality customer service and assistance to the users of our B2B AI-powered supply chain platform. Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week, UK business hours (GMT)

Role Type: Independent Contractor

Rate: Approximately Php400 - Php465/hour (depending on experience)

The company: You'll be working with an innovative UK-based tech startup whose AI-powered supply chain management software creates outcome-driven and smarter supply chains. The platform pulls complex data and leverages AI to monitor changes, test solutions, and respond to disruption in real time for mature and high-growth businesses.

What you'll do: This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you will manage inbound queries, diagnose technical issues, and escalate complex problems to second-line support. In short, you'll be the operational front line for customer success, ensuring support tickets are handled swiftly while proactively contributing to reporting, QA software testing, and platform improvements.

Customer Support & Ticket Management

  • Respond promptly and professionally to user queries via email, chat, or phone, ensuring a consistently high level of customer satisfaction.

SLA Monitoring & Operations

Feedback & Platform Improvement

  • Gather user feedback and observe recurring trends to provide actionable suggestions to product and engineering teams.
  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams to feed customer and market knowledge directly into our quarterly product roadmap.
  • Continuously refine customer service processes and workflows for better efficiency, responsiveness, and service quality.

Communication & Empathy:

  • Convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical users with high empathy, adjusting tone to match customer context and mood.
  • Stay calm under pressure, managing multiple incoming queries systematically without compromising quality.

About you:

  • Legally eligible to work in the Philippines as an Independent Contractor
  • Strong fluency in written and verbal English with exceptional grammar and communication skills
  • Your own laptop/computer and secure, high-speed internet access
  • 2+ years in a Customer Support Agent role (or similar B2B tech customer-facing role)

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, high empathy, and strong attention to detail
  • Proven capability to manage multiple tasks under pressure while maintaining process focus

Bonus points:

  • Experience in a similar customer support role at a fast-paced B2B SaaS startup

raw.excerpt: About the Institute for Nonprofit Practice The Institute for Nonproﬁt Practice (INP) works to ensure that the nation’s nonproﬁt, public sector, and social impact leaders have the skills, knowledge, networks, and conﬁdence to boldly advance their organizations and missions and build a more equitable future for all.
raw.description:
About the Institute for Nonprofit Practice
The Institute for Nonproﬁt Practice (INP) works to ensure that the nation’s nonproﬁt, public sector, and social impact leaders have the skills, knowledge, networks, and conﬁdence to boldly advance their organizations and missions and build a more equitable future for all.

INP serves social impact leaders who are driving solutions to some of the most pressing issues of our time. Nonprofits constitute the third-largest sector of the U.S. workforce – nearly 1 in 10 workers – yet the sector continues to face a chronic deficit of investment in the people who power it. The types of peer-to-peer learning and exchanges that INP offers are needed more than ever as the sector wrestles with a set of challenges that have mounted over the past few years – including workforce shortages, high burnout and turnover rates, and a rising demand for services – that can significantly undermine organizational effectiveness. With an 19-year track record of delivering programs that measurably increase leaders’ key leadership skills, confidence, and networks, INP is committed to meeting this moment by continuing to empower social impact leaders to adapt and thrive amidst these obstacles.

About the Role - Senior Grant Writer
As the Senior Grant Writer, you serve as the primary author and strategist for all grant proposals, letters of intent, prospective funding scenarios, and donor reports. You hold end-to-end accountability for the narrative quality, accuracy, strategic positioning, and timeliness of every institutional submission. Deeply attuned to funder priorities and the nuances of institutional philanthropy, you translate INP’s mission, community impact, and strategic vision into compelling, persuasive narratives that resonate with foundation and corporate partners.

Reporting to the Director of Institutional Giving, you are an integral member of a collaborative seven-person development team. In this role, you steward an established institutional portfolio of roughly 30 local and national funders—representing gifts typically ranging from $100,000 to over $2 million and totaling more than $7 million in annual institutional support.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Grant Writing & Submission: Write and submit approximately 30 proposals/LOIs and 30 reports annually (averaging just over one submission per week), crafting compelling narratives that reflect INP’s voice, mission, and strategic priorities.
  • End-to-End Project Management: Own the grant lifecycle from initiation to final delivery, tracking deadlines, maintaining the master institutional giving calendar, and ensuring strict adherence to foundation guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with program, finance, and executive leadership to source financial data, program metrics, and impact narratives needed for robust proposals and donor reporting.
  • Prospect Research & Pipeline Development: Guide prospect research strategy and landscape analysis to identify and qualify up to $1M in new funding opportunities annually, partnering with Development Coordinators to execute detailed research and build out prospect profiles.

What You’ll Need
  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, with a proven track record of writing successful institutional fundraising proposals.
  • Exceptional writing and self-editing skills, coupled with an appreciation for a collaborative, team-based editorial process.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM to log outreach, manage pipeline data, and track conversion milestones.
  • Comfort leveraging modern workplace tools and AI applications to streamline communications and day-to-day operations.
  • Ability to work gracefully under pressure, manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and meet strict deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions while executing independently to achieve organizational fundraising goals.
  • An authentic commitment to INP’s mission and a dedication to advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

Who You Are
  • An Effective Writer. You write well and take pride in your ability to do so, especially when given the opportunity to communicate an idea, topic, or vision that you are passionate about.
  • Resourceful and Adaptable. You’re nimble and flexible. You possess a positive attitude and identify creative solutions to obstacles. You can juggle many important responsibilities at once and you’re rigorous about prioritizing.
  • Self-motivated. You take the initiative, identifying problems and opportunities across your portfolio, developing recommendations, and taking action on those recommendations.
  • A Humble Teammate. Nothing is beneath or above you. You are quick to always lend a hand or two! You are able to earn influence without authority and naturally seek to support small projects or large strategic goals.
  • An Abundant Thinker. You operate from the belief that the right coalition of partners can unlock transformative possibilities. You approach relationship building with relentless curiosity and genuine enthusiasm.
  • Impact-Driven. You are motivated by social justice and energized by the opportunity to strengthen, connect, and elevate social sector leaders nationwide.

Compensation, Benefits, and Location
INP provides a competitive salary that is benchmarked annually against Boston-area nonprofits. The hiring range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000 annually. The ﬁnal salary within this range will be determined based on candidate's qualifications and relevant experience. New staff are rarely brought in at the top of the range to ensure internal equity and to leave room for salary growth during an employee’s tenure at the Institute for Nonprofit Practice.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Employer-covered health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) for all team members
  • Eleven paid holidays and winter and summer breaks for collective rest and restoration.
  • 401(k) with a 3% employer match of employee contributions.
This is a full-time, fully-remote position. Limited travel is expected; 2-4 times per year.


The Application Process
INP has engaged Equitable Hiring Group to support this hiring process. To apply, please complete the short form to the right.

Please submit your application by Wednesday, November 4th. Our simple process makes it easy to apply early!

To ensure an equitable review, we ask that you remove the names of the schools you attended (both undergraduate and graduate) from your resume. Please retain the degree itself. For example, instead of "Greendale Community College - B.A. Economics," simply list "B.A. Economics."

This evaluation process will follow practices shown to reduce bias in decision-making and may be different from other application processes you have experienced.

The overall evaluation process will look to follow this anticipated timeline:
  • Early November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a short-answer questionnaire.
  • Mid-November: Selected candidates will participate in a video interview with INP staff.
  • Mid-November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid, timed trial project.
  • Late November: Selected candidates will participate in a video panel interview with multiple team members.
  • Early December: Finalist candidates will interview with leadership, either via Zoom or in-person.
  • Mid-December: Offer extended.
If you have any questions about the opportunity, please email .

Company Overview

Our client builds an all-in-one booking and park-management platform for outdoor hospitality. Campground, RV park, and glamping operators use it to manage reservations, availability, rates, payments, guest messaging, and reporting in one place. It also runs a traveler-facing marketplace that brings operators more bookings.

Many customers are small and mid-sized businesses whose busiest days depend on the software running smoothly. They choose this platform for its ease of use and for the real, hands-on support behind it.

Your Role

This role exists to keep customers successful long after onboarding ends.

You'll be the go-to contact for a portfolio of parks. You'll answer questions, solve problems, and help operators use more of the platform as their business grows. Success in this role means customers feel supported, use the product confidently, and stay with the platform year after year.

Great for people with customer service experience who want to move into sales.

You’ll:

  • Serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of active customers

  • Answer product questions and troubleshoot issues with bookings, rates, payments, and availability

  • Run check-ins and training sessions to help customers adopt features they aren't using yet

  • Help operators adjust their setup as seasons, rates, or site inventory change

  • Stay calm and responsive during peak-season rushes, when every booking counts

  • Write clear follow-up notes and keep customer records up to date in the CRM

  • Turn recurring questions into guides, FAQs, and simple help documentation

  • Spot at-risk accounts early and work proactively to keep customers happy

raw.description:
We're looking for a Sr. Data Modeler to design and govern the data models that serve as the foundation for analytics, reporting, and business intelligence across the organization — with particular depth in semantic and metrics-layer modeling. Beyond traditional schema design, you'll build the semantic layer that sits between raw data and downstream consumers (dashboards, reverse-ETL syncs, AI-assisted querying), working closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to keep definitions consistent everywhere they're used.

What you'll get to do:

  • Contribute to the semantic layer strategy — defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic once so they're consistent across BI tools, reverse-ETL syncs, and AI-assisted querying
  • Design serving-layer models as the "source of truth" for business definitions, resolving ambiguity before it reaches dashboards
  • Build and govern semantic views/metrics layers (e.g., Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics/semantic layer) that let analysts and AI tools query curated data without re-deriving business logic
  • Partner directly with analytics and BI consumers to understand how models get used downstream, and iterate on semantic definitions based on real query patterns
  • Reduce metric drift by auditing existing reports/dashboards for divergent definitions of the same business concept and consolidating them into governed semantic models

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in data modeling or a related field, including experience operating at a senior or technical lead level
  • Experience designing or maintaining a semantic layer or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Snowflake semantic views, Cube) that serves multiple downstream consumers
  • Strong point of view on the difference between a data model and a semantic model, and how to design for both correctness and analyst usability
  • Advanced SQL skills and deep understanding of relational database design
  • Experience modeling data within modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience working with transformation frameworks such as dbt
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, and documentation practices
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical designs and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
  • Foundational background in dimensional modeling (Kimball and/or Inmon) — helpful context, though this role emphasizes semantic/metrics layer design over traditional schema work
  • Experience with data catalog or governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Atlan)
  • Familiarity with data mesh or data product concepts
  • Background in a specific industry domain relevant to the business (e.g., finance, healthcare, retail)
