About Green Ocean Property Management

Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our operating model depends on accurate financial information, disciplined execution, strong managers, and people systems that can scale with the company.

Position Summary

The Director of Finance & People Operations is the senior functional leader responsible for the company’s financial discipline and HR operating system. Reporting to the COO, this person leads through the Controller and HR Manager and ensures both teams produce timely, accurate, decision-ready work without depending on the COO for day-to-day management.

This is not primarily a bookkeeping role or an HR-generalist role. It is a manager-of-managers position for someone who can connect financial performance, workforce decisions, internal controls, and manager accountability. The right person will make the business more predictable: leadership will know where the company stands financially, managers will understand the numbers and people outcomes they own, and finance and HR processes will run reliably.

Core Outcomes

The Director will be accountable for the following outcomes:

  1. Reliable financial close and reporting — Monthly financial statements are accurate, reconciled, completed on the approved close calendar, and translated into clear actions for leadership.
  2. Forward-looking financial control — Leadership has a current cash forecast, budget, operating forecast, and early warning on material risks or variances.
  3. Clear financial accountability — Each department manager understands and owns the revenue, cost, staffing, and operating metrics assigned to that function.
  4. Strong internal controls — Corporate books, client/property books, payroll, billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and cash controls have clear ownership, documented review steps, and escalation rules.
  5. A dependable people system — Recruiting, onboarding, performance management, retention, compensation administration, employee relations, and offboarding operate consistently and legally.
  6. Independent, accountable teams — The Controller, HR Manager, and their teams have clear scorecards, decision rights, development plans, and the ability to deliver without the Director redoing their work.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and hold the Controller accountable for month-end close, account reconciliations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll accounting, financial reporting, and finance-team performance.
  • Oversee finance managers and accounting teams supporting the company’s operating entities and property-management segments.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between corporate financial reporting and client/property accounting, including disciplined use of QuickBooks Online for company books and Buildium for client/property books.
  • Own the annual budgeting and forecasting process, including department-owner budgets, operating assumptions, cash planning, scenario analysis, and monthly variance reviews.
  • Produce a concise monthly management package covering revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, labor, cash, receivables, payables, budget variances, and material risks.
  • Partner with operating leaders to improve profitability, pricing discipline, billing completeness, collections, labor efficiency, and cost control.
  • Establish and enforce internal controls, approval limits, reconciliation standards, segregation of duties, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure leadership can distinguish source-system facts, estimates, forecasts, and proposed decisions.
  • Coordinate tax, insurance, banking, audit, and outside-accounting relationships as assigned.
  • Improve finance systems, dashboards, data quality, and automation while retaining appropriate human review over financial decisions and postings.

HR and People Operations Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and hold the HR Manager accountable for the performance of the HR team and the quality of company-wide people processes.
  • Translate the company plan into a workforce plan covering required roles, hiring priorities, capacity, compensation cost, and succession risk.
  • Ensure recruiting uses clear role scorecards, structured interviews, hiring-manager calibration, documented decisions, and measurable pipeline reporting.
  • Oversee onboarding, offboarding, employee records, payroll coordination, benefits administration, leave administration, and required compliance processes.
  • Maintain a practical performance-management system with clear role expectations, regular one-on-ones, documented feedback, performance improvement plans, and timely reviews.
  • Track and improve time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, performance-review completion, and required training completion.
  • Guide managers on employee relations, documentation, coaching, and escalation; engage employment counsel or a qualified HR partner when legal interpretation is required.
  • Develop compensation ranges, promotion criteria, and career paths that are internally consistent and tied to demonstrated capability—not title or tenure alone.
  • Build an HR team that can independently operate recruiting, retention, administration, and manager-support workflows.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the COO’s principal leader for finance and HR operations.
  • Convert financial and people data into a short, prioritized executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.
  • Participate in leadership planning, operating reviews, annual planning, and major staffing or investment decisions.
  • Identify risks early and bring a recommendation—not only a problem—to the COO and CEO.
  • Set weekly operating cadences and scorecards for both functions, and ensure agreed actions are completed and verified.
  • Protect confidential employee, payroll, client, and financial information and maintain appropriate access controls.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Director is expected to independently improve routine finance and HR processes, enforce approved controls and deadlines, manage the two functions, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on major hires or terminations, executive compensation, material policy changes, unbudgeted commitments, financing, acquisitions, legal settlements, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO.

This role owns operational finance and people leadership. It is not automatically a CFO seat: capital strategy, investor relations, fundraising, and mergers and acquisitions are included only when expressly assigned.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Finance

  • Month-end close completed on the approved calendar.
  • All material balance-sheet accounts reconciled, with no unexplained material exceptions.
  • Weekly 13-week cash forecast maintained and reviewed against actual results.
  • Monthly financial package delivered on time with actionable variance explanations.
  • Every department completes its scheduled budget-versus-actual review.
  • Accounts receivable, accounts payable, unbilled work, and collection exceptions remain within approved targets.
  • Payroll, tax, banking, and required financial filings are completed accurately and on time.

People Operations

  • Approved roles have current scorecards and active hiring plans.
  • Time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, and voluntary turnover are reported and improved against agreed targets.
  • Onboarding, performance reviews, compliance training, and offboarding documentation are completed on time.
  • Payroll and benefit changes are accurate and submitted by deadline.
  • The HR Manager and Controller consistently deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in accounting or finance, including responsibility for close, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and internal controls.
  • Experience leading managers and building teams that produce accurate work independently.
  • Working knowledge of HR operations, including recruiting, performance management, payroll/benefits coordination, employee relations, compensation administration, and employment compliance.
  • Experience in a multi-entity, service, property-management, real-estate, or similarly operationally complex business.
  • Strong ability to turn financial and people data into clear decisions for non-finance leaders.
  • Demonstrated judgment with confidential employee and financial information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, and comfort holding peers and managers accountable.
  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and practical experience with accounting, property-management, payroll, HRIS, and reporting systems.
  • Ability to lead a distributed or remote team across functions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • CPA, CMA, MBA, SHRM-CP/SCP, or comparable professional qualification.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online, Buildium, BambooHR, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.
  • Experience improving close speed, cash forecasting, billing completeness, collections, retention, or manager accountability with measurable results.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

  • Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.
  • Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.
  • Paid Holidays

Leadership Profile

The strongest candidate will:

  • lead through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision;
  • be rigorous without creating unnecessary bureaucracy;
  • challenge assumptions respectfully and use source data before drawing conclusions;
  • distinguish urgent work from high-value work;
  • solve recurring problems through process, ownership, and systems;
  • coach managers while still holding a firm performance standard; and
  • communicate bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.

Internal Hiring Note

Because this position directly leads both the Controller and HR Manager, the hiring process should test four distinct capabilities:

  1. ownership of a finance function;
  2. judgment in hiring and workforce planning;
  3. successful management of managers and distributed teams; and
  4. the ability to run company-wide accountability processes without confusing process ownership with direct management of every manager.

A strong accounting candidate without proven people leadership is not sufficient. A strong HR leader without command of close, cash, budgeting, controls, and management reporting is also not sufficient.

raw.description:
Error-bounded lossy compression has become an important technique for reducing the storage and I/O costs of large-scale scientific data while providing strict control over data distortion. Existing compressors typically exploit spatial or temporal correlations through predefined prediction models, which may not effectively capture the complex underlying dynamics of scientific datasets. In this work, we plan to investigate the use of Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) to improve error-bounded lossy compression. We wukk evaluate the approach on representative scientific datasets and compare it with state-of-the-art error-bounded lossy compressors. Our results will demonstrate the potential of incorporating data-driven SINDy data predictor into scientific data compression and provide insights into when SINDy-based prediction can improve compression ratios and downstream data quality.

Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at .

Meet Your Future Neighbors

As a Product Manager on the Search team, you'll take on one of the most consequential rebuilds at Nextdoor. Search is the most explicit statement of intent a neighbor makes on the platform, and most searches aren't commercial at all: a lost-pet post, a neighbor's name, a school thread from last week, and sometimes a plumber. Search has been under-resourced for years and it shows. That changes now, with executive sponsorship, dedicated investment, and a blank sheet. You'll own the rebuild end to end, organic and monetized search together, from the quality of every result to how sponsored content earns its place on the page.

We're looking for a search expert who has done this before: someone who has owned consumer search, made it measurably better for users, and defined the relevance and quality metrics to prove it. You'll need real commercial literacy too. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with the ads and monetization side, built genuine empathy for why the business needs to extract value from search, and you know firsthand how sponsored content, ad load, and paid-organic blending actually behave. You know that great search monetization makes results better, not worse, and you've seen engagement and revenue grow together when both sides pull in the same direction. This is a multi-year rebuild rather than a tuning exercise, and you won't do it alone: dedicated data science partners, ML engineers with search backgrounds, and design coverage are committed to the team. Ideally, you've also built beyond search and bring the range of a generalist athlete who can flex across consumer, marketplace, and business-facing problems. You'll partner closely with engineering, data science, research, design, and PMM to turn that thinking into shipped experiments with real, measurable impact.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

TheImpact You’ll Make

  • Build the missing foundation first: define the metric that tells us whether a neighbor found what they came for, and make it the measure every experiment and ship call answers to. It does not exist today, and it's the most important thing you'll deliver in your first six months
  • Own the Search rebuild end to end, organic and monetized together, from query understanding and retrieval to ranking, result quality, and how the page comes together
  • Make the majority of searches work: most queries are a neighbor looking for a post, a person, a place, or an answer, with no commercial intent, and today we fail them too often
  • Partner with dedicated data science and ML engineering on query understanding, retrieval, and ranking, going deep on the mechanics when the details matter
  • Design how organic and sponsored content blend on the page, including placement, ad load, relevance thresholds, and monetization-eligibility routing, so paid results appear only where a business is the genuine answer
  • Grow revenue on the minority of queries with commercial intent, connecting neighbors to local businesses through organic and sponsored placements, with relevance as the guardrail revenue never overrides

What You’ll Bring To The Team

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including deep ownership of consumer search at scale and clear wins in making it better for users
  • Working knowledge of information retrieval fundamentals, including query understanding, retrieval, and ranking, plus experience defining search relevance and quality metrics from scratch and shipping ML- or LLM-powered search features
  • Experience working directly with the monetization side of search, whether you owned it or partnered closely with ads and revenue teams, and genuine empathy for how the business extracts value from search
  • A track record of growing engagement and revenue together, with the judgment to know when monetization improves the user experience and when it degrades it
  • Strong consumer product instincts built from shipping experiences used at scale, and genuine curiosity about how neighbors search for and find local information
  • A strong track record designing and analyzing A/B tests, including balancing revenue metrics against engagement guardrails, and translating ambiguous or conflicting signals into a clear ship decision
  • Range beyond search: you've shipped in adjacent areas like growth, marketplace, ads, or 0-to-1 products, and you flex quickly as the team's needs evolve
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, a bias toward action, and the appetite for a multi-year rebuild rather than a quick optimization win

Rewards

Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $170,000 - $250,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location.

We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.

When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.

At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

For information about our collection and use of applicants’ personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here.

Do you thrive on bringing order to complex, client-facing technology projects? Does leading cross-functional teams, to deliver real results energize you?


Come Join ReSource Pro!

Your Role...

ReSource Pro is seeking a Project Manager, Technology Services to lead multiple client-facing engagements, ensuring the successful planning, execution, and delivery of software implementation and related projects. This role develops comprehensive project and resource plans, coordinates cross-functional teams, manages timelines and budgets, mitigates risks, and maintains strong client relationships to achieve desired outcomes.

We hire the best because our service is only as good as the people delivering it. We're committed to hiring individuals who engage in our amazing culture and embrace our Core Values: Commitment to Community, Teamwork, Passion for Excellence, Service-Centric, and Best Self.
All remote positions are based in the United States, and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.

In this role, you will...
  • Develop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation, ensuring alignment with client expectations
  • Lead project teams from initiation through delivery, driving adherence to budget, timelines, and quality standards
  • Monitor project scope and risk, proactively identifying, escalating, and resolving issues that could impact schedule, cost, or performance
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients, building strong relationships from analyst to executive level
  • Provide clear, timely, and transparent status updates, managing expectations and addressing escalations to maintain client confidence
  • Foster a respectful, collaborative, and solution-oriented team environment
What You Need to be Successful...
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field
  • PMP certification preferred, but not required
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in software implementation or program/project management within IT/software delivery environments; P&C insurance experience preferred
  • Proficiency in MS Project and project management tools (ClickUp preferred)
  • Knowledge of policy administration, claims management, and vendor solutions (Insurity, Majesco, Guidewire, Duck Creek, etc.)
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, adapting to shifting priorities and timelines
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 25% of the time
  • Technological proficiency – able to learn, utilize, and navigate a variety of external and internal systems
Your Compensation…
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes annual bonus eligibility, benefits, and other opportunities at ReSource Pro. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity relative to other ReSource Pro employees. The salary range may vary based on experience and on the specific geographic location in which the candidate resides.

Your Benefits & Perks…
  • 100% paid employee health insurance available on Day 1
  • Eligible for all medical, dental, and vision benefits on Day 1
  • Remote positions are Internet stipend-eligible
  • 401k with employer match, vested on Day 1
  • HSA/FSA available
  • Long Term and short-term disability employer-provided
  • Generous PTO plan with paid holidays + floating holidays
  • Development and growth opportunities
  • Comprehensive wellness program and prioritization of employee health
Your Interview Process…
To be considered for this position, please submit your application. If you meet the qualifications for the role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to schedule an interview via zoom.
The standard interview process includes:
  1. Behavioral interview with Talent Acquisition
  2. Online talent assessment
  3. Hiring Manager interview
*Additional interview steps may be added depending on the position or if further evaluation is needed.
Disclosure: Candidates are evaluated at each step of the process. As a result, not every candidate will complete all steps in the process.

About ReSource Pro:

Focused exclusively on the insurance industry, ReSource Pro is the trusted partner insurance organizations rely on to optimize performance, streamline operations and process engineering, and drive growth. Serving 2,000+ carriers, brokers, wholesalers, and MGAs, ReSource Pro is a recognized market leader in insurance workflow optimization, data and technology services, and strategic operating model transformation. Maintaining a 96%+ client retention rate for over a decade, ReSource Pro is the only firm serving the insurance industry to have earned a spot on the Inc. 5000 list 16 times—placing it among the top 0.02% of repeat honorees across all sectors in the Inc. list’s 40+ year history.

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

ReSource Pro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Desde Prometeo Talent estamos acompañando a una empresa tecnológica especializada en infraestructura financiera en la incorporación de un/a Enterprise Sales Executive para desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en Colombia.

Buscamos un perfil comercial senior, con experiencia en ventas B2B de soluciones tecnológicas para el sector financiero, que disfrute del desarrollo de nuevos negocios, la construcción de relaciones estratégicas y la gestión de procesos comerciales complejos.

Es una oportunidad para integrarse a un equipo regional, participar en el crecimiento del negocio y trabajar con soluciones tecnológicas orientadas a la transformación del ecosistema financiero.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?

  • Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades comerciales con bancos, fintechs, instituciones financieras y empresas del ecosistema tecnológico.

  • Gestionar el ciclo comercial completo, desde la prospección y detección de necesidades hasta la negociación y el cierre.

  • Construir relaciones con interlocutores estratégicos y tomadores de decisión en áreas de Tecnología, Producto, Riesgo, Compliance, Pagos y Operaciones.

  • Desarrollar una cartera de oportunidades comerciales y generar nuevos negocios.

  • Comprender los desafíos de los clientes y construir propuestas de valor alineadas con sus necesidades.

  • Gestionar negociaciones complejas con múltiples interlocutores.

  • Trabajar de forma coordinada con los equipos regionales de Marketing, Producto y Comercial.

  • Dar seguimiento a las oportunidades y objetivos comerciales mediante herramientas CRM.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo comercial y ventas B2B, preferentemente con clientes Enterprise.

  • Experiencia comercializando soluciones tecnológicas a bancos, fintechs o instituciones financieras.

  • Conocimiento del ecosistema de tecnología financiera y experiencia en ventas consultivas.

  • Experiencia generando nuevas oportunidades de negocio y gestionando negociaciones hasta su cierre.

  • Capacidad para relacionarse con decisores senior y gestionar ciclos de venta complejos.

  • Experiencia trabajando con herramientas CRM.

  • Inglés intermedio/avanzado.

  • Residencia en Colombia.

Valoraremos especialmente experiencia comercial en alguna de estas soluciones:

  • APIs e integraciones tecnológicas.

  • Infraestructura financiera, pagos y Open Banking.

  • Verificación de identidad (KYC/KYB).

  • Prevención de fraude, Compliance y gestión de riesgo.

  • Soluciones tecnológicas para industrias de alto riesgo regulatorio (high-risk).

¿Qué habilidades harán la diferencia?

Buscamos una persona con marcada orientación a resultados, autonomía e iniciativa comercial.

Alguien que se sienta cómodo identificando oportunidades, abriendo puertas y desarrollando relaciones de largo plazo con clientes estratégicos.

Será importante contar con pensamiento consultivo, capacidad de negociación y facilidad para comprender soluciones tecnológicas complejas y traducirlas en oportunidades de negocio.

¿Qué ofrece esta oportunidad?

  • Integración a una empresa tecnológica con presencia regional.

  • Modalidad de trabajo 100% remota desde Colombia.

  • Participación activa en el desarrollo comercial del mercado colombiano.

  • Interacción con equipos multidisciplinarios y regionales.

  • Esquema de compensación fija y variable asociado a objetivos comerciales.

  • Contratación bajo modalidad de prestación de servicios (contractor).

Si tenés experiencia desarrollando negocios en el ecosistema fintech y te motiva trabajar con soluciones tecnológicas para el sector financiero, nos gustaría conocerte.

raw.excerpt: About the WorkThe founder has spent several years building a marketing framework that is becoming a book, a community office hours series, and a full curriculum.
raw.description:
About the Work

The founder has spent several years building a marketing framework that is becoming a book, a community office hours series, and a full curriculum. It also powers our software. Everything we teach and sell rests on evidence, so we are hiring a researcher to build and protect that foundation.

The Role

You will work directly with the founder to turn the framework into an education program that holds up to scrutiny, and to supply the research our software is built on. You find the strongest evidence, tell us what it does and does not support, and help shape what we teach.
The role starts with research and grows into curriculum and test building, and into using AI to create marketing assets. How fast it grows depends on how quickly you establish the foundation for the framework. The founder is preparing much of the material for you to take over.

What You Will Own

  • The evidence library for the book, starting with the relationship marketing claims
  • A research pass on every office hours outline: each claim checked section by section, newest research first, with a claims and sources list the founder reviews before anything is cited
  • The curriculum structure: one core question and one takeaway for each chapter, learning objectives for each, and a path through the office hours topics
  • Tests and assessments for the curriculum, including questions that check what learners understood
  • Prompts and workflows that use AI to create marketing assets, built with the founder and checked against the evidence
  • Behavioral science input on how buyers think and decide, which feeds the buyer psychology behind each session and each persona in our software
  • Market research for new products, including target markets, buyer segments, and inputs to competitor discovery
  • Short summaries of new academic and industry research that affect the framework

What You Bring

  • A background in behavioral science, such as psychology, behavioral economics, or consumer decision-making
  • Hands-on experience with research methods, both quantitative and qualitative
  • Marketing experience, ideally in both B2B and B2C settings
  • Strong judgment about which sources deserve trust, and the habit of checking the original study instead of a summary of it
  • The ability to write findings in plain language that a business owner can use
  • AI fluency: you write clear prompts, build repeatable workflows, and check what AI returns against the original sources

Nice to Have

  • Experience building curriculum, training programs, assessments, or educational content
  • Familiarity with positioning, brand strategy, or innovation research

How We Will Measure Success

  • Week 2: an audit of the evidence library with every unsourced claim listed by chapter
  • Day 45: gaps closed for the foundation chapters and a draft curriculum outline for the first level
  • Day 90: the full curriculum outline and a research brief on the first target market

Hours and Pay

  • Part time, 20 to 30 hours a week
  • $40 per hour

How We Work

  • You present findings first, and nothing gets cited in a public asset until the founder approves it
  • Recent research leads, and older foundational work is included when it still holds
  • The founder makes the final call on what the framework says
  • You will work closely with the portfolio content marketer, who turns approved findings into messaging and sales assets

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead high-impact product initiatives across TestAssure’s platform. In this role, you’ll operate as a senior individual contributor who combines strategic product thinking with strong execution leadership. You’ll own complex problem spaces end-to-end—driving product direction, aligning stakeholders, and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.

This is a great role for someone who thrives in a lean environment, enjoys ambiguous challenges, and can work closely with engineering, services, go-to-market teams, and leadership. In this role, you will also build and shape how the Product team will operate and collaborate at TestAssure.

What You’ll Do

  • Own key product areas from discovery through launch and iteration, with clear success metrics.
  • Translate company strategy into product initiatives, and prioritized work.
  • Lead customer discovery, synthesize feedback, and use data to identify opportunities.
  • Define product requirements and shape solutions in partnership with Engineering and Success.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Support, Leadership).
  • Support and improve product foundations (scalable product ops processes and tooling)
  • Partner with GTM teams on positioning, pricing/packaging considerations, launches, and enablement.
  • Ensure product experiences are scalable, intuitive, and measurable—balancing UX, tech constraints, and business needs.
  • Create clear documentation: product briefs, requirements, decision docs, and release notes/announcements
  • Interact with other product team members working together to raise the bar on craft, clarity, and customer-centric decision-making.

What Success Looks Like (First 3-6 months)

  • You own a major product bet or cross-team initiative that produces measurable impact (revenue, adoption, retention, efficiency).
  • Initiatives and delivery cadences are smoother: priorities are crisp, decisions are documented, and outcomes are measurable.
  • Teams trust your product judgment and clarity of direction.
  • You strengthen our product culture through better discovery, experimentation, stakeholder alignment and improved ways of work

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of PM (and/or PO experience), including SaaS/B2B or Enterprise background
  • Proven track record shipping successful products as an individual-contributor in high-ownership, fast-paced environments.
  • Track record of leveraging excellent UX instincts to simplify complex systems into intuitive, user-friendly experiences
  • Strong product craft across discovery, road mapping and prioritization, execution planning, and data-informed decision making, with the ability to structure ambiguous problem spaces into actionable plans
  • Uses AI tools to rapidly prototype and iterate on designs in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Comfortable navigating technical debate and articulating the rationale behind product decisions with engineering, including scoping and technical constraints (no coding required)
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Experience leading change management, influencing team behavior and workflows without formal authority
  • Familiarity with product analytics tools, experimentation, and customer research workflows

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Workforce Management or similar environments
  • Experience in QA tools/workflows or automation platform products
  • Experience in designing and delivering AI/LLM based products
  • Experience supporting pricing/packaging, monetization, or growth initiatives
  • Experience in standing up data/insights foundations contributing to product success
  • Prior experience at a startup or company under ~100 employees

Benefits

Why Join Us

  • High impact role with visibility across the business.
  • Opportunity to shape product strategy and execution in a growing SaaS company.
  • Direct access to customers and company leadership.
  • A collaborative, pragmatic team that values outcomes over process.
  • Low egos, PE-backed, remote team (US and CA), health insurance, 401(k) employee match.
  • Compensation is expected to be in the range of $110,000 to $140,000 USD. Remuneration and title will be based on experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Location: Remote, North America, Eastern Time Zone working hours

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Head of Product

raw.description:
SOX Automation Engineer

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SOX Automation Engineer with a strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance processes and extensive experience designing, architecting, and implementing automation solutions across complex enterprise IT environments.

The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of SOX IT controls with strong automation engineering capabilities to develop scalable, repeatable, and auditable solutions that reduce manual compliance efforts, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the organization's internal control environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess existing SOX processes and identify opportunities to reduce manual compliance activities through automation.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise-wide SOX automation architecture and implementation roadmap.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using Ansible, Chef, and other appropriate technologies.
  • Implement standardized SOX automation across multiple enterprise architectures, operating systems, applications, and infrastructure platforms.
  • Automate control execution, evidence collection, compliance validation, exception reporting, and remediation workflows.
  • Collaborate with audit and compliance teams to ensure automated solutions satisfy SOX control objectives and evidence requirements.
  • Monitor and continuously improve the effectiveness, reliability, scalability, and maintainability of SOX automation solutions.

Required Qualifications

SOX Compliance and IT Controls Expertise

  • Deep understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance requirements, particularly SOX Section 404 and IT General Controls (ITGCs).
  • Extensive experience with SOX processes, including access management, change management, configuration management, IT operations, and evidence collection.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to automate manual SOX controls while maintaining compliance and audit readiness.
  • Ability to translate SOX control requirements into technical specifications and automated workflows.
  • Experience working with internal audit, external auditors, cybersecurity, and compliance teams.

SOX Automation Strategy and Architecture

  • Demonstrated ability to architect and execute an enterprise-wide SOX automation strategy across diverse technologies, platforms, and infrastructure environments.
  • Ability to assess existing SOX processes, identify automation opportunities, and develop a comprehensive automation roadmap.
  • Experience designing scalable, reusable, and standardized automation frameworks that can support multiple business units and IT environments.
  • Ability to develop automation architectures that integrate with existing enterprise systems, security controls, and compliance platforms.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based automation approaches, prioritizing controls based on compliance impact, complexity, and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to establish automation standards, governance practices, and technical design principles.

Automation Engineering and Development

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing and implementing automation solutions using tools such as Ansible, Chef, and other infrastructure automation technologies.
  • Experience developing automated workflows for SOX control execution, validation, monitoring, remediation, and evidence collection.
  • Ability to create reusable automation scripts, playbooks, cookbooks, and configuration management solutions.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About HeyDelegate

HeyDelegate is a staffing partner that connects growing US-based companies and agencies with highly skilled professionals from Africa.

We go beyond simply filling positions. We thoughtfully match companies with professionals who can integrate into their teams, take ownership of their responsibilities and contribute meaningfully to long-term growth. Our focus is on quality, strong communication, professional maturity and building successful working relationships.

As HeyDelegate enters its next stage of growth, we are looking for a Brand & Marketing Lead who can strengthen how the company is positioned, communicated and experienced across every key touchpoint.

About the Role

This is not a social media management or content coordination position.

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on brand marketer who can help define what HeyDelegate should be known for, sharpen how we communicate our value and translate that strategy into compelling campaigns, content and marketing assets.

You will work closely with the founder to understand the company’s vision, customers, services and competitive position. You will then take ownership of developing a distinctive brand and marketing direction that supports HeyDelegate’s growth among US-based agencies and other target companies.

The ideal candidate understands that branding is more than visual identity or consistent posting. You should be able to develop positioning, messaging, campaigns and narratives that influence how the market understands and remembers a company.

You must also be comfortable executing the strategy. This role requires someone who can move between high-level brand thinking and practical implementation without waiting for a large team or external agency.

This will begin as a contract-based engagement, with the opportunity for the scope and level of involvement to expand as the company grows and the working relationship develops.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Brand Positioning and Strategy

    Develop and continuously strengthen HeyDelegate’s brand positioning, value proposition, messaging pillars, audience definition and competitive differentiation.

  2. Brand Narrative and Messaging

    Create clear, distinctive messaging that communicates the quality of HeyDelegate’s talent, matching process, ongoing support and value as a long-term staffing partner.

  3. Campaign Development

    Develop integrated brand and marketing campaigns that build awareness, credibility and trust among US-based agencies and other target clients.

  4. Content Strategy

    Build and manage a content strategy across LinkedIn, email, the HeyDelegate website, case studies and other relevant channels. Content should be purposeful, insight-led and connected to the company’s broader commercial goals.

  5. Website Messaging and Brand Experience

    Review and improve the structure, messaging and overall brand experience of the HeyDelegate website, ensuring that it clearly communicates the company’s positioning and supports lead generation.

  6. Case Studies and Sales Assets

    Develop strong, proof-based case studies, service materials, presentations and other assets that demonstrate HeyDelegate’s capabilities and support the sales process.

  7. Customer and Market Research

    Conduct ongoing research into HeyDelegate’s clients, prospective customers, competitors and market to identify insights that can strengthen the brand and inform future campaigns.

  8. Founder and Team Collaboration

    Work closely with the founder and internal team to extract company insights, customer stories and subject-matter expertise, then translate them into effective brand communications. HeyDelegate should remain the central brand.

  9. Creative Direction

    Provide clear strategic direction for visual assets, photography, video and design to ensure that all creative work supports a consistent and distinctive brand identity.

  10. Marketing Execution

    Personally execute priority marketing initiatives while coordinating with designers, videographers, writers or other external partners where required.

  11. Performance Measurement

    Establish appropriate brand and marketing metrics, evaluate campaign performance and use the findings to improve future strategy and execution.

  12. Brand Consistency

    Ensure that HeyDelegate’s voice, positioning and presentation remain consistent across marketing, sales, recruitment and client-facing materials.

  13. Perform any other related brand and marketing responsibilities that may reasonably be required as the company grows.

Requirements

  • At least five years of relevant experience in brand strategy, brand management, strategic marketing, communications strategy or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience helping shape or reposition a brand, not only managing its social media accounts.
  • Strong understanding of brand positioning, audience segmentation, messaging architecture and campaign strategy.
  • Experience translating brand strategy into content, websites, email campaigns, case studies and sales materials.
  • Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how brand and marketing support business growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong research, critical-thinking and storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to work directly with a founder, organize incomplete ideas and turn them into clear strategic direction.
  • Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions and move work forward without constant supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow briefs and deadlines precisely.
  • A proactive and highly responsive working style.
  • Experience working with B2B service companies, staffing businesses, professional-services firms or agencies would be an advantage.
  • Experience marketing to US-based businesses would be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with website content, SEO, email marketing and marketing analytics is beneficial.
  • Candidates with backgrounds in brand strategy, advertising strategy, account planning, integrated marketing or strategic communications are encouraged to apply.

This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If
  • Your experience is primarily limited to scheduling social media posts and creating content calendars.
  • You view branding mainly as logos, colours and visual consistency.
  • You require a fully developed strategy before you can begin executing.
  • You are uncomfortable taking ownership of both strategic thinking and implementation.
  • You rely heavily on generic or AI-generated marketing language without developing an original point of view.
  • You struggle to communicate promptly, follow detailed briefs or meet deadlines.

Location

This is a remote position. Candidates based in Kenya, particularly those who can occasionally attend in-person meetings or content activities in Nairobi, are strongly preferred.

Exceptional candidates based elsewhere in Africa may also be considered.

raw.description:
Drafter / Takeoff Specialist – Commercial Roofing, Cladding & Architectural Sheet Metal

Role Overview

We are looking for detail-oriented Drafters to produce shop drawings and material takeoffs for commercial roofing, cladding and architectural sheet metal projects. Your takeoffs jump-start procurement so Project Managers can review, finalize and release material orders months before field measurements are available. We welcome candidates with experience in roofing, cladding, or sheet metal, or any combination of these. Candidates will be matched to project types based on their background.

Workflow

  • Project is awarded and handed off from estimating to the PM.

  • Drafter prepares shop drawings and completes the initial material takeoff from the same set, working primarily from contract/architectural drawings (DWG/PDF).

  • Takeoff is reviewed with the team; Project Managers review and finalize before any order is placed.

  • Takeoff/cut list is delivered to the PM as an organized Excel sheet (plus Autodesk layout exports where useful) so materials can be released to external suppliers.

  • Turnaround is set per task and project scope. Tasks can range from a few hours to multi-week drawing sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Takeoffs:Perform quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. Roofing: square footage, membrane (e.g., TPO/PVC), insulation board counts, fasteners, edge metal, flashing. Cladding and sheet metal: panel counts and lengths, clips, trims, flashing, coping, master-sheet optimization for ACM/MCM, and linear footage for field roll-forming.

  • Cut lists & orders:Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

  • Shop drawings:Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

  • Review & release:Walk takeoffs through with the team, incorporate PM feedback, and release materials once finalized.

  • Quality:Verify quantities against drawings, engineering, manufacturer specifications and local codes before release.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience:Drafting experience is the core requirement. An experienced superintendent / senior superintendent who has installed systems and done their own takeoffs is also a strong fit.

  • Industry knowledge:Experience in commercial roofing, cladding, or architectural sheet metal (one or more) is preferred but not required. Experience in both roofing and cladding/sheet metal is a plus. Must read architectural drawings and understand material limitations (e.g., trims, panel widths, sheet optimization).

  • Technical skills:Proficiency in Autodesk/AutoCAD (team uses 2025) and Bluebeam (or Adobe Acrobat Pro); strong Excel skills.

  • Core attributes:High attention to detail, accuracy under deadlines, and ability to manage multiple projects at once.

  • Communication:Clear written and verbal English for working with Project Managers and the wider team.

Tools, Equipment & Device Requirements

  • Software seats:A license/seat will be provided for every program required for the role (e.g., Autodesk/AutoCAD, Bluebeam).

  • Own device: If working on a personal computer, it must be able to run AutoCAD and Bluebeam reliably. Devices will be checked against the specifications below during screening.

  • Monitors & accessories:Candidates must provide their own dual-monitor setup and associated accessories (keyboard, mouse, headset with microphone, webcam, cables/docking).

Schedule & Work Arrangement

  • Employment type:Full Time

  • Days:Monday through Friday

  • Working hours:US business hours, Central Time (9:00 AM–5:00 PM CT; 8:00 AM–4:00 PM CT also acceptable)

  • Location: Fully Remote

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

  • Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

  • Opportunities for continuous career growth.

raw.description:
Coretek is seeking a Network Engineer – L3 to design, implement, support, and continuously improve enterprise network and network security environments across Azure, hybrid, and on-premises data centers for managed services clients. This role owns complex routing, switching, firewall, SD-WAN, and cloud connectivity solutions, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into resilient, secure, and supportable network architectures.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on experience with Palo Alto and Fortinet firewalls, Azure networking, and enterprise LAN/WAN with strong troubleshooting discipline and client-facing communication. The engineer serves as the senior escalation point for network incidents, leads root cause analysis, reduces recurring issues, and drives standards, automation, and continuous improvement across the managed network estate.

Key Responsibilities

Azure & Hybrid Cloud Networking

  • Design, deploy, and support Azure network architectures including hub-and-spoke, Virtual WAN, VNets, peering, UDRs, NSGs, and Private Endpoints/Private DNS.
  • Implement and troubleshoot hybrid connectivity using site-to-site VPN, point-to-site VPN, and ExpressRoute.
  • Configure and support Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, Azure Load Balancer, Front Door, and DNS services.
  • Align network designs to Cloud Adoption Framework landing zone connectivity guidance and Well-Architected principles.
  • Maintain network diagrams, IP address plans, architecture decisions, and configuration standards.

Network Security & Firewalls

  • Design, deploy, and manage Palo Alto (PAN-OS, Panorama, VM-Series) and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) firewalls on-premises and in Azure.
  • Build and maintain security policies, NAT, IPsec tunnels, GlobalProtect/remote access VPN, URL filtering, and threat prevention profiles.
  • Apply Zero Trust and network segmentation principles across cloud and data center environments.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews, policy cleanup, and security posture assessments, and create prioritized remediation plans.
  • Coordinate with security operations teams on threat investigations, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.

Enterprise LAN/WAN & Data Center

  • Support and optimize routing and switching environments, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, and Layer 2/Layer 3 designs.
  • Manage SD-WAN, wireless, load balancing, and data center network infrastructure.
  • Plan and execute network upgrades, migrations, firmware/OS lifecycle management, and data center-to-cloud transitions.
  • Validate capacity, redundancy, and failover designs to meet availability commitments.

Managed Services Support, Escalation & Reliability

  • Provide L3 escalation support for complex network, firewall, connectivity, and performance issues across multiple clients.
  • Lead technical triage, packet capture and traffic analysis, service restoration, and coordination with ISPs, vendors, and client teams.
  • Perform root cause analysis, document corrective actions, and eliminate recurring incidents through engineering improvements.
  • Improve network monitoring, alert quality, runbooks, and change and maintenance procedures.
  • Participate in an escalation/on-call rotation and provide clear, timely status communications during major incidents.

Automation & Operational Excellence

  • Automate network deployment and configuration tasks using Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, PowerShell, or Python.
  • Develop and enforce network standards, templates, and configuration baselines across client environments.
  • Review incident, ticket, and capacity trends to identify proactive improvements.
  • Track remediation completion, risk reduction, and service stability outcomes.

Client Advisory & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted network advisor and escalation point for managed services clients.
  • Lead network design reviews, technical discovery, and recommendation readouts.
  • Mentor Systems Engineers and service desk staff and build reusable troubleshooting guidance and knowledge articles.
  • Collaborate with Azure, security, EUC, service delivery, and account teams; support presales discovery and client onboarding into managed services.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including 4+ years as a Cloud Network Engineer supporting multiple clients and systems.
  • Hands-on experience designing and supporting Azure networking and hybrid connectivity in production environments.
  • Strong experience administering Palo Alto and/or Fortinet next-generation firewalls.
  • Experience providing L3 escalation support, leading major incident triage, and completing root cause analysis in a managed services or multi-client environment.
  • Proven ability to move between design, hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and client communication.

Technical Expertise

  • Azure Networking: VNets, hub-and-spoke, Virtual Wan
  • ExpressRoute, VPN, and hybrid connectivity
  • Palo Alto PAN-OS, Panorama, and VM-Series
  • Fortinet FortiGate and FortiManager
  • Routing & Switching:BGP, OSPF, VLANs
  • SD-WAN, load balancing, and DNS
  • Zero Trust, segmentation, and Azure Firewall
  • Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, and network automation

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) – required
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Professional
  • Fortinet Certified Professional: Network Security
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Next-Generation Firewall Engineer
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
  • CCNP Enterprise or equivalent

Desired Characteristics

  • Disciplined, methodical troubleshooting and strong network design judgment
  • Consultative, client-focused communication during normal operations and high-severity incidents
  • Ownership, accountability, urgency, and bias for action
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across cloud, security, and support teams
  • Strong documentation, knowledge transfer, and diagramming skills
  • Coaching mindset and willingness to grow the technical capability of the team
  • Commitment to secure, stable, automated, and standards-driven network outcomes

Success Metrics

Performance Area -- Measure of Success

  • Network Reliability -- Reduced network-related incidents, outages, and repeat issues
  • Security Posture -- Firewall policy hygiene, closed findings, and measurable risk reduction
  • Cloud Connectivity -- Secure, scalable, and supportable Azure and hybrid network implementations
  • Escalation Support -- Effective L3 ownership, timely restoration, and quality root cause analysis
  • Automation & Standards -- Reusable templates, configuration baselines, and reduced manual effort
  • Documentation -- Current diagrams, IP plans, runbooks, and knowledge articles
  • Change Quality -- Successful changes and migrations with minimal unplanned impact

raw.description:
Le groupe inhérent, dont unycest la BU Vente indirecte, c'est plus de 1300 collaborateurs, 40 agences, 14 datacenters, et un chiffre d’affaires de 300 M€ en 2024. Nous sommes un acteur de référence dans la commercialisation de solutions télécom et IT en France.

unyc, c’est plus de 220 collaborateurs, 3 sites (Le Mans, Paris, Caen), un chiffre d’affaires de plus de 90 millions d’euros et un réseau de près de 1400 partenaires. Depuis 20 ans, nous repoussons les limites des technologies de la communication, avec une croissance ininterrompue et une forte accélération ces 5 dernières années.

Notre ambition est claire : proposer aux entreprises les meilleures solutions Télécom, IT et Cyber à travers un accompagnement de proximité.

Nous opérons exclusivement en indirect, en accompagnant nos partenaires dans la commercialisation de nos offres, tout en restant attentifs aux besoins des clients finaux qu'ils adressent.

Es-tu prêt à relever tous les défis ?

# Tes futurs CHALLENGES

En intégrant notre Equipe CommercialeVentes Indirectes Distribution, tu rejoins une équipe de 12 personnes et tu auras la charge de développer, promouvoir notre activité, recruter, former et animer le réseau de partenaires distributeursunyc sur la région NORD/HAUTS DE FRANCE.

Tes principales missions consisteront à :

  • Elaborer et mettre en place les plans d'actions commerciales

  • Développer un portefeuille de partenaires et fidéliser le parc existant

  • Prospecter, identifier et comprendre les besoins des prospects

  • Elaborer les propositions commerciales et techniques

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’ensemble des services internes.

Assurer un reporting régulier de ton activité auprès de la direction.

# Le poste est fait pour TOI si

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience commerciale dans les télécoms ou l’IT

  • Tu aimes former, encadrer et animer un réseau de partenaires

  • Tu as le goût du challenge et la culture du résultat

  • Tu veux t’investir dans un projet d’entreprise ambitieux et en pleine croissance.

# Ce que l’on recherche

Nous, ce qu’on recherche avant tout, ce sont des talents qui viendront enrichir notre groupe et se reconnaitront dans nos valeurs : être orienté CLIENT, penser COLLECTIF, faire preuve de BON ESPRIT et montrer de l’AUDACE !

# Notre PROMESSE

Rejoindre unyc, c’est l’assurance de :

  • Travailler dans un cadre agréable, avec des équipes fun et dynamiques,

  • Avoir des perspectives d’évolution à court, moyen et long terme,

Nous rejoindre, c'est aussi rejoindre un acteur qui mène une politique RSE engagée et reconnue grâce à la mise en place d'actions concrètes telles que la réduction de la consommation d'énergie dans nos datacenters, le recyclage des matériaux et des déchets, la limitation de notre empreinte carbone et la mise en avant de valeurs humaines et professionnelles fortes pour ne citer que ces exemples.

On a fini de te convaincre ? A toi de jouer maintenant !

# Notre PROCESS de recrutement

C’est simple, tu n’as plus qu’à cliquer sur le bouton « postuler ».

Un premier échange par téléphone avec les RH, un entretien avec ton futur manager, et l’aventure peut commencer !

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Regional Associate to join a new outreach team supporting property hosts across the West Coast and Beach region. In this role, you will use data to help hosts understand how their listings and pricing compare across booking platforms. You will also share education, tips, and insights that help them make informed decisions. This is a phone-heavy, relationship-driven role, a blend of business development and junior account management. It is well suited to someone early in their career who enjoys outbound outreach and building rapport quickly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze listing optimization opportunities and performance trends across a portfolio of high-potential host accounts, and act on data-driven opportunities that help hosts attract more bookings
  • Make a high volume of outbound calls, roughly 10-20 per day, and reach hosts through video meetings and email, following up consistently across channels
  • Present data clearly using charts and approved tools, and explain the platform's value to hosts
  • Help hosts understand how their pricing compares across booking platforms, and address common questions and objections
  • Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integrations with various software partners
  • Document conversations, classifications, and follow-ups in Salesforce, Gong, and team trackers
  • Track progress toward quarterly goals and adjust your approach weekly
  • Share learnings, objections, and best practices with the team
  • Follow host communication guidelines at all times: educate and inform, provide objective, data-driven insights, and empower hosts to make their own pricing and business decisions

Qualifications

Required

  • Comfort on the phone and on video, with the ability to build rapport quickly with people you have never met
  • Comfort with outbound outreach and a high daily call volume
  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage a large portfolio and a daily call plan
  • Curiosity and comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, spot a pattern, and explain it simply
  • Persistence and resilience: you can follow up many times, respectfully, without taking silence personally, and adapt quickly to different conversations
  • Good judgment and integrity when working within compliance guidelines

Preferred

  • 1-2 years of experience in inside sales, business development, account management, or host or partner success and onboarding, ideally at a marketplace or tech platform
  • Customer service, sales, or hospitality experience (internships count)
  • Bachelor's degree completed or expected within the next 6 months (any field)
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce), call-intelligence tools (Gong), or outreach tools (Mixmax)
  • Experience with spreadsheets and dashboards (Google Sheets, Tableau)
  • Interest in travel, short-term rentals, or online marketplaces

What to Expect

  • A structured ramp-up with guided training and competitive intelligence sessions
  • Tool walkthroughs with teammates for Salesforce, Gong, Mixmax, and team dashboards and trackers
  • Shadowing on host calls during your first weeks
  • Weekly performance data and regular coaching to support your growth

Key Details

  • Start date: Mid-November 2026
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Location: Remote (within the U.S.), Eastern or Central time zone preferred
  • Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (8 hours/day, 5 days/week)
  • Pay rate range: $20-$23/hour + benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(K))
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Engagement: W-2 Contract

raw.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description


Job Description

Responsible for performing loan analysis verification activities by working with customers, bankers, vendors and underwriters through in-bound telephone support and outbound pipeline ownership. Helps customers and bankers understand the loan approval process and underwriting requirements by analyzing specific loan transactions and reviewing documentation for approval. Provides overall problem resolution for operational issues and has a clear understanding of all required stipulations to efficiently move loans through the loan approval process.

This position requires National Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS) registration under the terms of the S.A.F.E. Act of 2008 and Regulation Z. You will be subject to the required registration process, which includes a criminal background and credit check. Failure to meet or maintain any of the NMLS registration requirements, including maintaining a satisfactory criminal and credit record, may result in a rescission of your offer or termination of employment.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- One or more years of relevant experience

Preferred Skills/Experience

- Basic knowledge of underwriting and loan origination functions, systems, procedures, various products and/or services supported by the assigned area(s) and applicable Federal and State laws and regulations

- Basic knowledge of applicable credit products, programs, financial analysis and related documentation as applicable

- Basic knowledge of U.S. Bank policies and procedures as they pertain to Direct Lending processing and underwriting

- Basic knowledge of U.S. Bank systems to access information of status of loans in process

- Good organizational and project management skills

- Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

- Strong customer service skills

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously


This role has multiple levels, open to candidates with 2-4 years of experience. The successful candidate will be hired for the level of the position that aligns with their experience.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave

  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan

  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities

  • Adoption assistance

  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

The salary range reflects figures based on the primary location, which is listed first. The actual range for the role may differ based on the location of the role. In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Pay Range: $23.75 - 29.03

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. U.S. Bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA). In addition, certain positions may also be subject to the requirements of FINRA, NMLS registration, Reg Z, Reg G, OFAC, the NFA, the FCPA, the Bank Secrecy Act, the SAFE Act, and/or federal guidelines applicable to an agreement, such as those related to ethics, safety, or operational procedures.

Applicants must be able to comply with U.S. Bank policies and procedures including the Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and related workplace conduct and safety policies.

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.

Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • EST: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • PH Time: 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

Position Overview

The Architectural Project Manager – Construction Administration (PMCA) serves as the firm's on-site representative during construction and is responsible for managing the architectural aspects of projects through the construction phase. This role coordinates with clients, consultants, contractors, government agencies, and internal staff to ensure projects are constructed in accordance with approved plans, specifications, contracts, and applicable codes.

Key Responsibilities

Construction Administration

  • Manage bidding and construction phase activities.
  • Attend and facilitate construction meetings.
  • Review and process:
    • Requests for Information (RFIs)
    • Shop drawings
    • Product submittals
    • Change orders
    • Extra service requests
    • Progress billings/pay applications
  • Conduct regular site visits and field observations.
  • Monitor construction progress for compliance with project documents.
  • Prepare punch lists and Certificates of Substantial Completion.
  • Review and coordinate as-built drawings and closeout documentation.

Project & Team Management

  • Collaborate with leadership on staffing and resource allocation.
  • Participate in performance management and hiring recommendations.
  • Contribute to firm-wide initiatives, standards, and process improvements.
  • Coordinate project staffing needs and scheduling.

Financial Management

  • Assist with project budgets and financial goals.
  • Monitor project performance and team utilization.
  • Identify and manage additional services opportunities.
  • Support invoicing, billing reviews, and collections activities.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a related field from an accredited college or university.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of construction administration, architectural project management, or related experience.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Architectural drawings and specifications
    • Construction contracts
    • Building codes and regulatory requirements
    • FHA, ADA, TCAC, and accessibility requirements
  • Experience with multiple construction types:
    • Type I, II, III, and V construction
  • Experience with project types such as:
    • Mixed-use developments
    • Podium projects
    • Wrap developments
    • Garden-style apartments
    • Modular construction

Core Competencies

  • Construction administration expertise
  • Project coordination and leadership
  • Client and contractor relationship management
  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Time management and organization
  • Financial and budget awareness
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail

Work Environment

  • Primarily remote/work-from-home position.
  • Requires dedicated home workspace and reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload).
  • Periodic travel to construction sites for meetings, inspections, and project reviews.

Why AO?

Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and the belief that great work happens when people are supported and challenged in equal measure. You’ll find a team that values:

  • Strong relationships, with clients and each other
  • A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality
  • Continuous learning and professional growth
  • Thoughtful design paired with technical rigor

At AO, you will work alongside colleagues who care deeply about what they do and are committed to building something meaningful together.

Benefits

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team. Highlights include:

  • Medical, dental, life, and supplemental insurance
  • Most medical plans fully paid for employee-only coverage
  • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
  • Retirement plan, health savings, and flexible spending accounts
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Free parking and convenient transit access
  • Employee discount program (OC location)
Salary: $110,000- $150,000
